Imperfection for Precision: Upcycling Imperfect Data for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation VLA

VLA data upcycling flow matching high-precision manipulation real robot

简要说明：本文提出 ε4P 方法，通过在流匹配VLA训练的不同噪声阶段分别使用低精度目标任务数据和高精度任务不匹配数据，从而利用不完美数据提升真实机器人操作精度，减少对昂贵高质量遥操作数据的依赖。

TLDR: This paper introduces ε4P, a method that upcycles imperfect data sources—low-precision target-task data and high-precision mismatched-task data—by using them at different noise levels in flow-matching VLA training, improving real-robot manipulation precision and reducing reliance on costly high-quality teleoperation data.

Abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models for high-precision manipulation typically requires task-specific, high-quality data (e.g., teleoperation), which is slow and expensive to collect. To reduce this burden without compromising manipulation precision, we propose $\varepsilon$4P (Imperfection for Precision), a simple yet effective method that "upcycles" two otherwise discarded data sources: (1) low-precision data from the target task and (2) high-precision data from mismatched tasks. Rather than naively mixing these imperfect data sources throughout co-training, $\varepsilon$4P controls where each source contributes along the flow-matching trajectory. Specifically, low-precision, target-task data is used at high noise to preserve high-level task context and high-precision, task-mismatched data is used at low noise to transfer low-level action precision. Through real-robot experiments on both sub-millimeter, high-precision tasks and coarse-grained tasks, we demonstrate that the proposed method (1) effectively leverages additional imperfect data to improve policy performance by up to 31.7 percentage points, and (2) can replace an equal amount of task-specific, high-quality data with an average performance drop of only 4.2 percentage points. Overall, $\varepsilon$4P points toward a scalable paradigm for high-precision manipulation, in which heterogeneous, imperfect data can be systematically repurposed to reduce reliance on costly task-specific, high-quality data. More details are available at https://varepsilon4p.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型以完成高精度操作任务，通常需要针对特定任务的高质量数据（例如遥操作数据），而此类数据的采集既缓慢又昂贵。为在不牺牲操作精度的前提下减轻这一负担，我们提出了一种简单而有效的方法——$\varepsilon$4P（Imperfection for Precision），该方法“升级再利用”了两种原本会被丢弃的数据来源：（1）目标任务中的低精度数据，以及（2）任务不匹配的高精度数据。与在整个共训练过程中简单混合这两种不完美数据源不同，$\varepsilon$4P 控制每种数据在流匹配轨迹中不同位置的贡献。具体而言，低精度的目标任务数据在高噪声阶段使用，以保留高层次的任务上下文；而高精度的任务不匹配数据在低噪声阶段使用，以迁移低层次的动作精度。通过在亚毫米级高精度任务和粗粒度任务上开展的真实机器人实验，我们证明了所提出的方法能够：（1）有效利用额外的不完美数据，将策略性能提升最多达31.7个百分点；（2）用相同数量的不完美数据替代任务特定高质量数据时，平均性能仅下降4.2个百分点。总体而言，$\varepsilon$4P 为高精度操作提供了一种可扩展的范式，在该范式中，异构且不完美的数据可以被系统性地重新利用，以减少对昂贵且任务特定的高质量数据的依赖。更多详情请访问 https://varepsilon4p.github.io/。

Authors: Hao Wei, Yang Liu, Chao Tang, Shengbao Li, Jiangtao Chen, Jinxuan Zhu, Jiaheng Wang, Hong Yin, Zhaofeng Cao, Tingguang Li

NavSafe-$\infty$: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Driving Safety in Photorealistic Environments AutonomousDriving

closed-loop benchmark end-to-end driving traffic safety taxonomy open-loop vs closed-loop reward hacking

简要说明：NavSafe-infinity 提出了一个逼真的闭环基准，用于评估端到端驾驶策略，揭示了开环性能并不总能转化为闭环安全性，并暴露了常见补救措施的失败模式。

TLDR: NavSafe-infinity introduces a photorealistic closed-loop benchmark for evaluating end-to-end driving policies, revealing that open-loop performance does not reliably transfer to closed-loop safety and exposing failure modes of common remedies.

Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) driving policies have progressed rapidly on open-loop (OL) benchmarks, yet OL evaluation cannot reveal whether a policy withstands compounding errors, recovers from failures, or interacts safely with surrounding actors. We introduce NavSafe-$\infty$, a photorealistic closed-loop (CL) benchmark of 280 scenarios spanning 28 event types, each with success and failure criteria defined within a structured traffic-safety taxonomy, which yields category-level capability scores for Traffic Crashes, Vulnerable Road User Crashes, Traffic Violations, and Traffic Incidents. Evaluating 20 E2E policies, we find that OL gains do not reliably transfer to CL safety. Analyzing two common remedies further shows that passive demonstration perturbation helps mainly when CL rollouts stay near its perturbed training states, and that OL reinforcement-learning fine-tuning exhibits reward hacking by trading safety margin for ego progress, which CL feedback amplifies into compounding safety-critical errors. Together, these results demonstrate the blind spot of OL benchmarks indicating CL safety success. The benchmark and an extensible toolbox for customizable event curation and policy diagnosis will be open-sourced and maintained to facilitate future research.

摘要（中文）：端到端（E2E）驾驶策略在开环（OL）基准测试中取得了快速进展，然而开环评估无法揭示策略能否承受复合误差、从故障中恢复，或与周围交通参与者实现安全交互。我们提出NavSafe-$\infty$，一个包含28种事件类型、共计280个场景的照片级闭环（CL）基准测试，每个场景在结构化交通安全分类体系内定义了成功与失败标准，从而生成针对交通事故、弱势道路使用者碰撞、交通违规及交通事件等类别级能力评分。通过评估20种端到端策略，我们发现开环性能的提升并不能可靠地转化为闭环安全性。进一步分析两种常见补救措施表明，被动示范扰动主要仅在闭环轨迹接近其受扰训练状态时起到帮助作用；而开环强化学习微调则表现出奖励黑客行为，即以牺牲安全裕度为代价换取自车进度，且闭环反馈会将该行为放大为复合型安全关键错误。综上，这些结果揭示了开环基准在指示闭环安全成功方面的盲区。该基准测试及一个可扩展的工具箱（用于自定义事件策划与策略诊断）将开源并持续维护，以促进未来研究。

Authors: Yuxin Bao, Hongwei Ruan, Luobin Wang, Seth Z. Zhao, Ziyang Leng, Zihan Zhang, Yu Zeng, Rowan McAllister, Henrik Christensen, Bolei Zhou

Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models WorldModel

monocular drone navigation latent world model 3D Gaussian Splatting action-conditioned real-world deployment

简要说明：Skytopia提出一种基于动作条件潜在世界模型的单目无人机导航策略，在3D高斯泼溅场景上训练，部署时丢弃预测网络，并在仿真和真实室内外/林地环境中取得良好效果。

TLDR: Skytopia introduces a monocular drone navigation policy using an action-conditioned latent world model trained on 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, which discards the prediction network at deployment and achieves strong results in simulation and real-world indoor/outdoor/woodland flights.

Abstract: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.

摘要（中文）：单目无人机导航要求仅通过单个前视摄像头在未见环境中到达目标，而该设置提供的深度与尺度线索极为有限。世界模型通过建模观测如何在动作作用下演化来应对这一问题，但其构建目的是为了执行：预测在部署时生成，并在每个控制步骤中反馈至动作生成过程。我们认为，策略从世界模型中所需的并非预测本身，而是生成预测所需的表征：在飞行过程中，已执行的动作几乎解释了观测之间的全部变化，因此预测可简化为在已知位移下对静态场景进行重投影。为此，我们提出skytopia——一种基于动作条件潜在世界模型的策略，以及用于训练该模型的3D高斯泼溅平台。前向目标根据预期运动预测下一观测的表征，逆向目标则从预测的状态转移中恢复该运动。由于预测结果从不进入动作生成环节，预测器被舍弃，单一策略即可同时服务于点目标、图像目标及无目标导航任务。仿真实验表明，skytopia在三种任务设定下均优于所有基线方法，成功率分别达到57.8%、66.0%和49.0%，而舍弃预测器可减少59.4%的推理开销。该策略随后在未经微调的情况下部署于实体无人机，并在室内、室外开阔环境及林地环境中成功到达目标。

Authors: Yuhang Zhang, Rangya Zhang, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Weiying Wang, Steven Yang, Qingsong Yan, Chao Yan, Mir Feroskhan

MachEmbodied-U0: Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Embodied Intelligence VLA

Mixture-of-Transformers flow matching affordance grounding visual dynamics robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了 MachEmbodied-U0，一种统一的具身基础模型，通过混合Transformer架构将理解（子任务预测、可供性定位）与生成（基于流匹配的视觉动态和动作生成）相结合，在仿真和真实机器人操作基准上展现了强劲性能。

TLDR: This paper presents MachEmbodied-U0, a unified embodied foundation model that integrates understanding (subtask prediction, affordance grounding) and generation (visual dynamics and action generation via flow matching) using a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, demonstrating strong performance on simulated and real robotic manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: General-purpose robot control requires models to understand task intent, identify where to interact, capture how the scene evolves, and generate precise actions. Vision-language-action models provide strong semantic priors but typically do not explicitly model scene dynamics, while world-action models couple visual prediction with control without necessarily exposing the task-relevant semantic and spatial structure needed for fine-grained manipulation. We present MachEmbodied-U0 (ME-U0), a unified embodied foundation model connecting understanding and generation experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Subtask prediction and affordance grounding guide joint visual-dynamics and action generation via flow matching. Visual dynamics encompass future RGB, depth, surface normals, and optical flow, providing complementary supervision for appearance, geometry, and motion. Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) aligns visual dynamics with fine-grained control. We pretrain ME-U0 on approximately 4,200 hours of curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets. Using only the supervision natively available in each downstream benchmark, ME-U0 achieves an average score of 17.66 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and average success rates of 99.0\% and 82.5\% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, respectively. We additionally validate ME-U0 on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond simulation. Without corresponding downstream supervision, ME-U0 further demonstrates zero-shot subtask prediction, affordance grounding, and visual dynamics on simulated and real-world observations. Overall, ME-U0 combines competitive downstream control performance with transferable task-grounding and visual-dynamics capabilities across simulation and the real world.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人控制要求模型理解任务意图、识别交互位置、捕捉场景演变过程，并生成精确的动作。视觉-语言-动作模型提供了强大的语义先验，但通常不显式建模场景动态；而世界-动作模型将视觉预测与控制耦合，却未必揭示精细操作所需的与任务相关的语义和空间结构。我们提出MachEmbodied-U0（ME-U0），一种通过混合Transformer架构连接理解专家与生成专家的统一具身基础模型。子任务预测与可供性定位通过流匹配引导联合的视觉动态与动作生成。视觉动态涵盖未来RGB图像、深度图、表面法向量和光流，为外观、几何和运动提供互补的监督信号。多速率旋转位置编码（MRPE）将视觉动态与精细控制对齐。我们在来自机器人数据集和第一视角数据集的约4200小时精选演示数据上对ME-U0进行预训练。仅利用每个下游基准中原生可用的监督信息，ME-U0在RoboDojo仿真基准上取得17.66的平均得分，并在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上分别达到99.0%和82.5%的平均成功率。我们还在真实世界机器人操作任务上验证了ME-U0，证明了其超越仿真的有效性。在无相应下游监督的情况下，ME-U0进一步展示了在仿真和真实世界观测上的零样本子任务预测、可供性定位和视觉动态能力。总体而言，ME-U0将具有竞争力的下游控制性能与可迁移的任务定位和视觉动态能力相结合，横跨仿真与真实世界。

Authors: Haoran Wen, Wenfu Wang, Kunsong Shi, Jingke Wang, Wancheng Feng, Yiren Zhang, Yueran Zhao, Xuancheng Zhang, Nanfei Ye, Xingru Chen, Zhaohong Sun, Chengmin Yang, Zikang Yu, Penghao Bi, Jia Shi, Yu Liu, Kun Zhan, Yan Xie

CableVLA: Simulation-Privileged Global-Local Representation Learning for Cable Routing VLA

Vision-Language-Action Cable routing Tactile sensing Topology distillation Sim-to-real

简要说明：CableVLA是一种用于电缆布线的端到端视觉-语言-动作框架，将仿真特权的拓扑和触觉监督转化为可部署的表示，在MuJoCo评估中将成功率从62.6%提升至84.9%。

TLDR: CableVLA is an end-to-end VLA framework for cable routing that distills simulation-privileged topology and tactile supervision into deployable representations, improving success rates from 62.6% to 84.9% in MuJoCo evaluations.

Abstract: Cable routing requires coordinated control of global cable topology and changing local contacts. We present CableVLA, an end-to-end multimodal vision-language-action framework that converts simulation-privileged supervision into deployable cable-topology and tactile representations. TopoHead distills node-level physics and current and future cable-topology information into causal visual context for the action expert. TacSense uses complementary frame and taxel branches to learn contact dynamics from resistive arrays, with simulator-derived kinematics and contact events providing supervision beyond the measured force map. A contact gate activates force-tactile residuals that refine the next 8 arm-and-gripper actions of a frozen topology-conditioned policy. Across 345 MuJoCo evaluations, CableVLA improves success from 62.6% for the $π_{0.5}$-V visual baseline to 84.9%. TacSense achieves pronounced gains in slip-transition recognition over a CNN-LSTM baseline with a similar parameter count, and this advantage persists under frozen-encoder probes. Topology prediction and 57-task tactile evaluations assess representation quality, while policy adaptation studies evaluate downstream control performance. Cross-simulator and real-robot comparisons further examine zero-shot policy transfer under changes in dynamics and sensing.

摘要（中文）：线缆布线需要对全局线缆拓扑结构和变化的局部接触进行协同控制。我们提出了CableVLA，一种端到端的多模态视觉-语言-动作框架，将仿真中的特权监督转化为可部署的线缆拓扑和触觉表示。TopoHead将节点级物理信息以及当前和未来的线缆拓扑信息蒸馏为因果视觉上下文，供动作专家使用。TacSense利用互补的帧分支和taxel分支从电阻阵列中学习接触动力学，模拟器导出的运动学和接触事件提供了超越所测力图的监督信号。接触门控激活力-触觉残差，以优化冻结的拓扑条件策略的后续8个手臂和夹爪动作。在345次MuJoCo评估中，CableVLA将成功率从$π_{0.5}$-V视觉基线的62.6%提升至84.9%。TacSense在滑移转换识别方面相比参数数量相近的CNN-LSTM基线取得了显著提升，且该优势在冻结编码器探测下依然保持。拓扑预测和57任务触觉评估用于衡量表示质量，而策略适应研究用于评估下游控制性能。跨模拟器和真实机器人对比进一步检验了在动力学和传感变化下的零样本策略迁移能力。

Authors: Zhifei Teng, Bo Feng, Xiang Zou, Jinpeng Xiao, Min Li, Zhouping Yin, Yiqun Li

VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

post-training quantization vision-language-action models closed-loop evaluation layer-specific precision LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：VLAQuantBench 提出了一个受控的闭环基准，用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型的后训练量化，识别了层作用域、数值格式和校准之间的配方依赖交互，这些交互显著影响任务成功率，并提供了不同层和任务的具体精度分配建议。

TLDR: VLAQuantBench introduces a controlled closed-loop benchmark evaluating post-training quantization on VLA models, identifying recipe-dependent interactions between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration that markedly affect success rates, with concrete precision assignments for different layers and tasks.

Abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration. We introduce \textbf{VLAQuantBench}, a controlled evaluation with 409 runs and 94,574 simulation episodes: four models on LIBERO, with X-VLA additionally evaluated on three simulation benchmark families. Under uncalibrated W4A4 round-to-nearest quantization, expanding a $π_{0.5}$ action-head subset from 126 to 167 layers raises success from 7.0\% to 70.5\%. Fixed-observation replay confirms a corresponding numerical recovery. Two-episode calibration removes the severe joint failures in the tested subsets, whereas the same smoothing-and-clipping recipe lowers $π_0$ success and does not recover OpenVLA-OFT end-to-end. For OpenVLA-OFT, protecting one 28,672-parameter output projection instead restores near-baseline success: the remaining 441 eligible linear layers retain W3 on LIBERO-Long or eight-bit activations across all four suites. Task-clustered intervals support the large failure and recovery contrasts. These results establish recipe-dependent interactions and identify concrete precision assignments, rather than universal layer-sensitivity rules. Real-kernel and physical-robot measurements complement the accuracy analysis. Code, configurations, and episode records are publicly available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/VLAQuantBench.

摘要（中文）：后训练量化减少了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的内存需求，但精度选择必须考虑层范围、数值格式与校准之间的相互作用。我们引入了 **VLAQuantBench**，一个受控评估框架，包含409次运行和94,574个仿真回合：在LIBERO上评估四个模型，并额外在三个仿真基准族上评估X-VLA。在无校准的W4A4就近取整量化下，将$π_{0.5}$动作头子集从126层扩展到167层，成功率从7.0\%提升至70.5\%。固定观测重放确认了相应的数值恢复。两轮校准消除了所测子集中严重的联合失败，而相同的平滑与裁剪方法却降低了$π_0$的成功率，且无法恢复OpenVLA-OFT的端到端性能。对于OpenVLA-OFT，保护一个包含28,672个参数的输出投影层即可恢复到接近基线的成功率：其余441个符合条件的线性层在LIBERO-Long上保留W3精度，或在其全部四个测试套件中保留八位激活。任务聚类区间支持了显著失败与恢复的对比结论。这些结果确立了依赖配方的相互作用，并识别出具体的精度分配方案，而非通用的层敏感性规则。真实内核与物理机器人测量补充了精度分析。代码、配置和回合记录公开于https://github.com/jiuyixu25/VLAQuantBench。

Authors: Jiuyi Xu, Qing Jin, Meida Chen, Song Wang, Yang Sui, Yangming Shi

ForeDrive: Foresight-Guided End-to-End Autonomous Driving with a Planning-Relevant Latent World Model AutonomousDriving

latent world model JEPA Diffusion Transformer planner end-to-end autonomous driving planning-relevant representation

简要说明：ForeDrive 提出了一种规划相关的潜在世界模型，将多时间范围的未来表征注入扩散Transformer规划器，在NAVSIM基准上实现了端到端自动驾驶的最先进PDMS性能。

TLDR: ForeDrive introduces a planning-relevant latent world model that injects multi-horizon future representations into a Diffusion Transformer planner, achieving state-of-the-art PDMS on NAVSIM benchmarks for end-to-end autonomous driving.

Abstract: Existing latent world models are typically optimized for future predictability, yet the resulting representations are not necessarily useful for planning in autonomous driving. Predictions are commonly used for pretraining or auxiliary supervision rather than as direct conditioning signals for trajectory generation. We propose ForeDrive, which learns a planning-relevant latent representation and couples it asymmetrically to a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) planner. The planner consumes multi-horizon latent future representations learned with a JEPA-style world model; planning gradients update the shared online encoder, while stop-gradient routing trains the latent predictor with forecasting losses only. Because predicted futures have varying reliability across horizons and BEV trajectories are misaligned with image tokens, we use gated visual fusion, future-status injection, and Trajectory-Adaptive Bias (TAB) to inject future latents as guidance without overriding the current observation. Trained with pure imitation learning and using only the current front-view image as visual input at inference, ForeDrive attains 89.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.0 one-stage EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, without reinforcement learning or an external trajectory scorer.

摘要（中文）：现有潜在世界模型通常以未来可预测性为优化目标，但其生成的表示未必适用于自动驾驶中的规划任务。预测结果通常用于预训练或辅助监督，而非直接作为轨迹生成的调节信号。我们提出ForeDrive，该模型学习一种与规划相关的潜在表示，并将其与非对称耦合的扩散Transformer（DiT）规划器结合使用。规划器利用以JEPA风格世界模型学习到的多时间跨度潜在未来表示；规划梯度更新共享的在线编码器，而停止梯度路径仅通过预测损失训练潜在预测器。由于预测未来在不同时间跨度上的可靠性存在差异，且鸟瞰图轨迹与图像标记不对齐，我们采用门控视觉融合、未来状态注入和轨迹自适应偏置（TAB）机制，将未来潜在信息作为引导注入，而不覆盖当前观测。ForeDrive仅使用纯模仿学习训练，并在推理阶段仅以当前前视图像作为视觉输入，在NAVSIM v1上达到89.9 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.0单阶段EPDMS，无需强化学习或外部轨迹评分器。

Authors: Sinuo Wang, Zichong Gu, Yuhan Huang, Wenxin Wen, Xun Yang, Yiqing Zhang, Xingyu Zhang, Ningyu Che, Jie Ling, Qiankun Yu, Wei Liu, Jing Xu, Xinggang Wang

DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

generative simulation closed-loop driving video world model end-to-end driving policy-oriented fidelity

简要说明：DreamStream提出了一个生成式闭环模拟器，利用模拟器根基的自回归视频模型实现面向策略的视觉保真度，并引入FDπ指标来评估模拟到现实的差距；构建了Navhard-CL基准用于交互式驾驶策略测试。

TLDR: DreamStream presents a generative closed-loop simulator with a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model to achieve policy-oriented visual fidelity, and introduces FDπ metric for evaluating sim-to-real gaps; it constructs the Navhard-CL benchmark for interactive driving policy testing.

Abstract: Faithfully evaluating end-to-end driving policies in simulation requires observations that are not merely photo-realistic, but preserve the scene features a policy relies on to make decisions. Existing platforms, however, exhibit a sim-to-real visual gap that corrupts policy perception, undermining their ability to assess a policy's closed-loop decision-making. To this end, we propose DreamStream, a generative, closed-loop simulator that achieves policy-oriented fidelity using a simulator-grounded autoregressive video model. Our video model is distilled from a large pretrained video model via traffic layout guidance, varying visual appearance while preserving policy-relevant features such as scenario layout and the temporal consistency of dynamic objects. We further observe that perceptual metrics like FID misrank how well these features are preserved. To tackle this, we introduce FD$π$, a new multi-representation metric that measures the sim-to-real gap as the Fréchet distance over scene-context features from public E2E policies. Under FD$π$, DreamStream improves over the strongest prior closed-loop simulator by $1.6\times$ on nuScenes and $4.7\times$ on NAVSIM, and induces the least perturbation to policy's perceptual observability. Based on DreamStream, we construct Navhard-CL benchmark, which turns non-reactive real-world benchmark NAVSIM into interactive testing environments with adversarial driving behaviors and weather variations. This benchmark exposes many failure modes of driving policies, such as scorer bias and lack of recovery behaviors, that prior closed-loop benchmarks overlook. Code and data are available at https://github.com/VAIL-UCLA/DreamStream.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在仿真环境中忠实地评估端到端驾驶策略，要求观测数据不仅具有照片级真实感，还必须保留策略在决策时所依赖的场景特征。然而，现有平台普遍存在仿真到现实的视觉差距，这会破坏策略的感知能力，从而削弱其在闭环决策评估中的有效性。为此，我们提出了DreamStream，一种生成式闭环仿真器，通过基于仿真器约束的自回归视频模型实现面向策略的保真度。我们的视频模型通过交通布局引导从大型预训练视频模型中蒸馏而来，在改变视觉外观的同时，保留与策略相关的特征，如场景布局和动态物体的时间一致性。此外，我们观察到诸如FID之类的感知指标在评估这些特征保留程度上存在排序错误。为解决这一问题，我们引入了FDπ，一种新的多表示指标，通过公开端到端策略的场景上下文特征之间的Fréchet距离来衡量仿真到现实的差距。在FDπ指标下，DreamStream在nuScenes上较最强先前闭环仿真器提升了1.6倍，在NAVSIM上提升了4.7倍，并对策略的感知可观测性扰动最小。基于DreamStream，我们构建了Navhard-CL基准测试，将非反应式真实世界基准NAVSIM转化为具有对抗性驾驶行为和天气变化的交互式测试环境。该基准揭示了驾驶策略中的多种失效模式，如评分器偏差和缺乏恢复行为，而现有闭环基准未能发现这些问题。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/VAIL-UCLA/DreamStream 获取。

Authors: Ziyang Leng, Sicheng Mo, Seth Z. Zhao, Haoyuan Cai, Yu Zeng, Rowan McAllister, Bolei Zhou

MSK-Bench: Benchmarking Full-Body Musculoskeletal Motor Control Across Tasks, Control Paradigms, and Physiological Metrics Locomotion

Musculoskeletal humanoid full-body motor control benchmark imitation priors physiological metrics

简要说明：MSK-Bench 提出了一个包含22个全身肌肉骨骼运动控制任务的标准化基准，系统评估了五种控制范式与生理指标，以联合分析任务成功率、鲁棒性和生理一致性。

TLDR: MSK-Bench introduces a standardized benchmark of 22 full-body musculoskeletal motor-control tasks, systematically evaluating five control paradigms and physiological metrics to analyze task success, robustness, and physiological agreement jointly.

Abstract: Musculoskeletal (MSK) humanoids provide a physiologically grounded embodiment for studying full-body motor control, but their high-dimensional muscle actuation, delayed activation dynamics, and redundant muscle--tendon structures make learning substantially harder than torque-driven humanoid control. Existing MSK benchmarks remain fragmented across gait, prosthetics, dexterous hands, or challenge-specific tracks, leaving full-body muscle-actuated control insufficiently evaluated under standardized tasks, methods, and metrics. We introduce MSK-Bench, a benchmark of 22 full-body motor-control tasks organized into three progressively challenging categories: postural stabilization, common locomotor behaviors, and contact-rich environmental interaction. Under unified task protocols and robustness perturbations, MSK-Bench evaluates 5 representative control paradigms, including reward-based RL, agentic reward tuning, latent-action RL, imitation-prior control, and residual adaptation over imitation priors. Beyond task success and reward, MSK-Bench further reports robustness analysis and physiology-oriented diagnostics, including activation cost, joint smoothness, and EMG-envelope similarity. Our empirical study shows that embodiment-aware exploration and structured action representations improve task coverage in high-dimensional muscle spaces, imitation priors enhance reference-compatible stabilization and locomotion but degrade under contact-rich terrain mismatch, and residual adaptation can recover successful behaviors when fixed references fail. We further find that improved task success does not necessarily imply improved physiological agreement, highlighting the importance of evaluating task performance, robustness, and physiological behavior jointly. MSK-Bench provides a task--method--metric testbed for full-body muscle-actuated humanoid control.

摘要（中文）：肌肉骨骼（MSK）类人机器人为研究全身运动控制提供了具有生理学基础的具身平台，但其高维肌肉驱动、延迟的激活动力学以及冗余的肌肉-肌腱结构，使得学习难度远高于力矩驱动的人形机器人控制。现有MSK基准测试在步态、假肢、灵巧手或特定挑战赛道之间较为分散，导致全身肌肉驱动控制缺乏在标准化任务、方法和指标下的充分评估。我们提出MSK-Bench，一个包含22项全身运动控制任务的基准测试，任务被组织为三个难度递进的类别：姿势稳定、常见运动行为以及富含接触的环境交互。在统一的任务协议和鲁棒性扰动下，MSK-Bench评估了5种代表性控制范式，包括基于奖励的强化学习、智能体奖励调优、潜在动作强化学习、模仿先验控制以及基于模仿先验的残差自适应。除任务成功率和奖励外，MSK-Bench还进一步提供了鲁棒性分析和面向生理学的诊断指标，包括激活代价、关节平滑度以及肌电包络相似度。我们的实证研究表明，具身感知的探索和结构化动作表征能提高高维肌肉空间中的任务覆盖度；模仿先验有助于提升与参考一致的稳定性和运动能力，但在富含接触的地形不匹配情境下性能下降；而当固定参考失败时，残差自适应可以恢复成功行为。我们还发现，任务成功率的提升并不必然意味着生理一致性的改善，这凸显了将任务性能、鲁棒性和生理行为联合评估的重要性。MSK-Bench为全身肌肉驱动的人形机器人控制提供了一个任务-方法-指标三位一体的测试平台。

Authors: Mengtao Ou, Zongzheng Zhang, Zhenghao Xiao, Yixuan Pan, Ziwen Zhuang, Hang Zhao, Hongyang Li, Yanan Sui, Libin Liu, Hao Zhao

Learning Air-Ground Motion Control with Temporal Mode Switching and Cross-Terrain Tracking RLRobot

air-ground motion control mode switching reinforcement learning trajectory tracking multi-terrain

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于被动轮式空地双模车辆的学习型运动控制框架，结合学习模式选择器和强化学习轨迹跟踪控制器，实现了可靠的空地切换和跨地形地面跟踪，并在仿真和实际实验中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a learning-based framework for passive-wheeled terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles, integrating a learned mode selector and an RL-based trajectory tracking controller for robust air-ground switching and cross-terrain ground locomotion, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Passive-wheeled terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles (TABVs) combine aerial mobility with energy-efficient ground locomotion. However, reliable air-ground mode switching under limited onboard perception and robust ground trajectory tracking across diverse terrains remain challenging when targeting real-world applications. In this work, we propose a learning-based air-ground motion control framework for passive-wheeled TABVs: 1) a learned mode selector for autonomous air-ground motion mode switching. The selector uses historical single-point time-of-flight (ToF) measurements and robot states together with future reference information to determine the active locomotion mode. 2) a reinforcement learning control policy for trajectory tracking. The policy combines proprioceptive observations with future reference information to anticipate trajectory changes. For ground locomotion, multi-terrain training and dynamics randomization enable robust tracking across different terrains. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate reliable air-ground switching under limited perception and accurate ground tracking across diverse terrain conditions. The learned selector outperforms a rule-based mode selector in challenging transitions, while the ground controller achieves lower position RMSE than PID across all tested conditions and maintains decent tracking where NMPC fails. With these capabilities integrated, the system tracks a 101m air-ground trajectory through multiple autonomous mode transitions with a position RMSE of 0.08m.

摘要（中文）：摘要：被动轮式空地两栖机器人（TABVs）将空中机动性与节能的地面移动能力相结合。然而，在面向实际应用时，受限于机载感知能力，可靠的空中-地面模式切换以及跨多样地形的稳健地面轨迹跟踪仍具挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于学习的空地运动控制框架，适用于被动轮式TABVs：1）一种学习型模式选择器，用于自主空地运动模式切换。该选择器利用历史单点飞行时间（ToF）测量数据、机器人状态及未来参考信息来确定主动运动模式。2）一种用于轨迹跟踪的强化学习控制策略。该策略将本体感觉观测与未来参考信息相结合，以预判轨迹变化。针对地面运动，通过多地形训练和动力学随机化，实现了跨不同地形的稳健跟踪。仿真和实际实验表明，在有限感知条件下空地切换可靠，且在不同地形条件下地面跟踪精准。学习型选择器在具有挑战性的过渡场景中优于基于规则的模式选择器，而地面控制器在所有测试条件下均实现了比PID更低的位置均方根误差（RMSE），并在NMPC失效的情况下保持了良好的跟踪性能。整合上述能力后，该系统通过多次自主模式切换完成了101米空地轨迹的跟踪，位置RMSE为0.08米。

Authors: Ruitian Pang, Mingrui Li, Xuanting Liu, Tiancheng Lai, Juncheng Chen, Xiangyu Li, Ruibin Zhang, Qishao Wang, Jin Yu, Haiyin Piao, Fei Gao, Chao Xu, Yanjun Cao

MATE: Multi-Agent Virtual Teleoperation Platform for Humanoid Collaboration Data Collection HumanoidEmbodied

multi-agent teleoperation humanoid collaboration data collection shared physics-based environment execution-aligned interaction sampling zero-shot transfer

简要说明：MATE是一个多智能体虚拟遥操作平台，允许地理分布的操作员在共享的物理仿真环境中同时控制全身人形机器人，以可扩展的方式收集协作数据。它还引入了EAIS采样策略，以改善从收集数据中学习策略的效果，并在真实人形机器人上实现了零样本迁移。

TLDR: MATE is a multi-agent virtual teleoperation platform enabling geographically distributed operators to control whole-body humanoids in a shared physics-based environment for scalable collaboration data collection. It also introduces EAIS, a sampling strategy to improve policy learning from the collected data, demonstrating zero-shot transfer to a physical humanoid.

Abstract: Humanoid robots require diverse embodied experiences to acquire complex loco-manipulation and collaborative skills. However, existing humanoid data pipelines primarily focus on individual agents, while physical multi-robot collaboration remains difficult to scale due to costly hardware, dedicated spaces, and repeated resets. In this work, we introduce MATE, a Multi-Agent virtual TEleoperation platform for humanoid collaboration data collection that enables multiple geographically distributed operators to simultaneously control whole-body humanoids in a shared physics-based environment. MATE removes the need for multiple physical robots and co-located operation while preserving physically coupled interactions among humanoids, objects, and environments. Using MATE, we construct a multi-humanoid collaboration dataset comprising 24.1 hours of coordinated behavior across 2,500 joint episodes and five long-horizon tasks, including object handover, relay delivery, environment interaction, and cooperative transport. To improve learning from these interaction-rich demonstrations, we introduce EAIS, an Execution-Aligned Interaction Sampling strategy that computes sampling signals within an execution-aligned prefix and prioritizes task-progressing and interaction-critical behaviors. We evaluate MATE with representative imitation learning and vision-language-action policies across diverse collaboration tasks. Experiments demonstrate efficient data collection, effective policy learning, and zero-shot transfer from virtual demonstrations to a physical humanoid without real-world fine-tuning. Project page: https://yerik-yu.github.io/MATE/

摘要（中文）：人形机器人需要多样化的具身经验，以获得复杂的移动操控与协作技能。然而，现有的人形机器人数据管线主要聚焦于单一智能体，而物理多机器人协作由于硬件成本高昂、专用空间需求以及频繁重置等问题，难以实现规模化扩展。在本工作中，我们提出了MATE——一个用于人形机器人协作数据采集的多智能体虚拟遥操作平台，该平台使多位地理上分布的操控者能够在共享的基于物理的仿真环境中同步控制全身人形机器人。MATE消除了对多台物理机器人及同址操作的需求，同时保留了人形机器人、物体与环境之间物理耦合的交互。利用MATE，我们构建了一个多人形机器人协作数据集，涵盖24.1小时的协调行为，包含2,500个联合回合和五项长时程任务，包括物体递送、接力运输、环境交互以及协同搬运。为提升从这些富含交互的示范中进行学习的效果，我们引入了EAIS（执行对齐交互采样）策略，该策略在执行对齐的前缀区间内计算采样信号，并优先选择推动任务进展和关键交互的行为。我们使用具有代表性的模仿学习策略和视觉-语言-动作模型，在多种协作任务上对MATE进行了评估。实验结果表明，该平台实现了高效的数据采集、有效的策略学习，以及从虚拟示范到物理人形机器人的零样本迁移，且无需真实世界的微调。项目主页：https://yerik-yu.github.io/MATE/

Authors: Yichuan Yu, Youzhuo Wang, Yiming Ren, Di Feng, Yexuan Yang, Bingxi Yang, Shengxiao Gong, Yujing Sun, Yuexin Ma

RouteRLT: Learning When and Which RL Specialist Should Control a Vision-Language-Action Policy VLA

routing framework RL specialist vision-language-action phase selector contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：RouteRLT提出一种学习路由框架，决定何时以及哪个RL专家应控制通用VLA策略，在LIBERO任务和真实电缆插入中提升性能，且部署时无需阶段边界。

TLDR: RouteRLT introduces a learned routing framework that decides when and which RL specialist should control a generalist VLA policy during precision-critical manipulation stages, improving performance on LIBERO tasks and real-world cable insertion without needing phase boundaries at deployment.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation competence, but often struggle during the precision-critical stages that dominate contact-rich industrial tasks such as connector insertion and cable management. A common remedy is to refine a pretrained VLA with reinforcement learning (RL), enabling task-specific improvement beyond behavior cloning. However, how to preserve its generalist behavior while deciding when RL refinement is needed and which specialized policy should act remains an open question. In this work, we present RouteRLT, a routing framework that learns when and which RL specialist, an RL policy trained for a single precision-critical phase, should take control from a generalist VLA. A phase selector identifies the active controller, a stabilizer suppresses transient switches, and an action-boundary manager handles transitions between chunked policy outputs. We evaluate RouteRLT on multi-object pick-and-place tasks in LIBERO, as well as on a real-world cable pickup and port-insertion task with multiple precision-critical stages. In simulation, the learned routing improves over the base VLA and matches routing with privileged phase boundaries, without accessing those boundaries at deployment. The real-robot evaluation validates automatic routing to both the pickup and insertion specialists under an operator-aligned handoff protocol. Altogether, these results show that learned routing applies RL specialist control where precise adaptation is most valuable while preserving generalist VLA behavior, including recovery from failed execution attempts.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了广泛的操控能力，但在以高精度关键阶段为主的接触密集型工业任务（如连接器插拔和线缆管理）中，往往表现不佳。一种常见的补救方法是通过强化学习（RL）对预训练的VLA模型进行微调，从而在行为克隆的基础上实现任务特定的改进。然而，如何在保持其通用行为的同时，决定何时需要强化学习精调以及应由哪个专用策略执行操作，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在本工作中，我们提出了RouteRLT，一种路由框架，用于学习何时以及由哪个RL专家（针对单一精度关键阶段训练的RL策略）接管通用VLA的控制权。相位选择器用于识别当前激活的控制器，稳定器用于抑制瞬态切换，动作边界管理器则负责处理分块策略输出之间的过渡。我们在LIBERO中的多目标抓取-放置任务，以及一个包含多个精度关键阶段的真实线缆拾取与端口插入任务上，对RouteRLT进行了评估。在仿真中，学习到的路由策略优于基础VLA，并且在没有访问相位边界的情况下，达到了与使用特权相位边界的路由相当的性能。真实机器人实验验证了在操作员对齐的交接协议下，能够自动路由至拾取和插入专家。总体而言，这些结果表明，学习到的路由能够在精确适应最为关键的阶段应用RL专家控制，同时保持通用VLA行为，包括从失败执行尝试中的恢复能力。

Authors: Chongyu Zhu, Jaden Hinds, Hyegang Kim, Juan Sebastian Rojas, Ramy Elmallah, Chi-Guhn Lee

Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training HumanoidEmbodied

text-to-motion humanoid retargeting simulation-based selection SONIC

简要说明：一种无需训练的流程，通过采样、重定向和模拟文本到运动候选并选择执行效果最佳的候选，在不进行额外训练的情况下提高人形机器人的硬件成功率。

TLDR: A training-free pipeline that samples, retargets, and simulates text-to-motion candidates and selects the best-executing one for a humanoid robot, improving hardware success without additional training.

Abstract: Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S$^3$) draws $N$ motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S$^3$ attains the any-of-$N$ ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with $N=8$, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation ($r=0.94$).

摘要（中文）：文本到动作模型能够生成合理的人体动作，但无法建模机器人动力学；全身跟踪控制器能够可靠执行机器人参考动作，却无法重新规划不可行的动作。近年来的语言到人形机器人系统通过训练弥合了这一鸿沟。我们衡量了在不进行任何训练的情况下，仅将部署控制器本身纳入循环，能弥合多大比例的差距。样本-仿真-选择（S$^3$）从冻结的文本到动作模型中为每个提示词采样$N$个动作，通过方向匹配逆运动学将每个动作重定向到Unitree G1机器人，在完整刚体动力学下使用预训练的SONIC跟踪策略对所有动作进行 rollout，并保留策略执行效果最佳的候选动作。由于验证器本身就是确定性仿真器，S$^3$ 从构造上达到了任意$N$候选的上界；我们测量的是该上界位于何处以及哪些因素导致未能达到该上界。在200个分层HumanML3D测试提示词上，$N=8$时，直立执行成功率从83.5%提升至89.5%，硬件门控通过数从33提升至85；在完整测试集（4,184个提示词）上，该指标从80.5%提升至89.5%。一个能够良好预测摔倒的动力学验证器（AUROC 0.90）仅能恢复这一增益的四分之一：对单个提示词的候选进行排序比分类整体分布更难。选择机制无法修正的一类问题是降低骨盆高度的提示词，而基于重定向机器人数据训练的生成器可以执行这类动作。我们进一步使用标准文本-动作评估器对执行动作的语义保真度进行评分，并通过真实动作捕捉对照将损失归因于机器人投影，针对GMR消融了重定向器（两者失败模式互补：任意8候选上界在两者联合时提升至95.0%），并在真实G1机器人上执行了全部177个门控选中的片段：每一个都完成了直立动作，硬件跟踪误差与仿真一致（$r=0.94$）。

Authors: Raphael Memmesheimer, Sven Behnke

SparseNav: Instruction-conditioned Sparse Semantic Perception for Training-Free Vision-Language Navigation VLN

vision-language navigation training-free sparse semantic perception bird's-eye-view map quadruped deployment

简要说明：SparseNav 提出了一种无需训练的视觉语言导航框架，通过指令条件下的稀疏语义感知构建轻量级 BEV 地图和地标记忆，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 上取得了有竞争力的成功率，并在四足机器人上完成了实际部署。

TLDR: SparseNav introduces a training-free vision-language navigation framework that uses instruction-conditioned sparse semantic perception to build a lightweight BEV map and landmark memory, achieving competitive success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE and demonstrating real-robot deployment on a quadruped.

Abstract: Map-based vision-language navigation (VLN) relies on persistent spatial representations to connect language understanding with geometric planning. However, acquiring semantics beyond the needs of the current instruction can introduce unnecessary perception cost and irrelevant annotations. Continuously accumulating unrelated objects may not only waste computation, but also clutter the visual-spatial representation consumed by the vision-language model (VLM) planner. To address this problem, we present SparseNav, a training-free framework that follows a less-is-more principle for semantic navigation. SparseNav persistently maintains a lightweight geometric bird's-eye-view (BEV) map and sparse landmark memory, acquiring new semantics on demand using the active sub-instruction to decide what is worth grounding. An instruction manager first tracks navigation progress and identifies the active landmark query. An instruction-conditioned perception mechanism then invokes open-vocabulary segmentation when the queried landmark is visible and its metric location can inform the next decision. The resulting landmark memory supports VLM selection among hybrid frontier and local directional waypoint candidates. Without any additional training, SparseNav achieves success rates of 42.8% on R2R-CE and 40.7% on RxR-CE, both on the Val-Unseen splits. Controlled ablations examine semantic perception strategies and the contributions of individual framework components. Furthermore, we successfully deployed SparseNav on a Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with an Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D camera for geometric mapping and landmark grounding and a Livox MID-360 LiDAR for localization, without a prebuilt map. We validated its effectiveness across multiple indoor environments using instruction-conditioned waypoint navigation.

摘要（中文）：基于地图的视觉-语言导航（VLN）依赖于持久化的空间表征来连接语言理解与几何规划。然而，获取超出当前指令需求的语义信息可能会引入不必要的感知成本和无关标注。持续累积无关物体不仅浪费计算资源，还会使视觉-语言模型（VLM）规划器所依赖的视觉-空间表征变得杂乱。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SparseNav，一种无需训练的框架，遵循“少即是多”的语义导航原则。SparseNav持久化维护一个轻量级的几何鸟瞰图（BEV）地图和稀疏地标记忆，通过主动子指令按需获取新语义，以判断哪些内容值得进行 grounding。指令管理器首先跟踪导航进度并识别当前活动的地标查询。随后，指令条件化感知机制在查询地标可见且其度量位置可为下一步决策提供信息时，调用开放词汇分割。由此产生的地标记忆支持VLM在混合前沿点与局部方向航路点候选之间进行选择。在无需任何额外训练的情况下，SparseNav在R2R-CE和RxR-CE的Val-Unseen分割上分别达到了42.8%和40.7%的成功率。受控消融实验考察了语义感知策略及各框架组件的贡献。此外，我们成功将SparseNav部署于搭载Intel RealSense D455 RGB-D相机（用于几何建图与地标grounding）和Livox MID-360 LiDAR（用于定位）的Unitree Go2四足机器人上，无需预先构建地图。我们通过指令条件化航路点导航在多个室内环境中验证了其有效性。

Authors: Quanhua Chen, Juhan Kang, Runfeng Lin, ZiFei Zhang, Enquang Feng, Chunran Zheng, Xiwang Dong, Jiarong Lin

MAVP: Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies for Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

Mobile manipulation Visuomotor policies Base-pose prediction Map-aware Localization feedback

简要说明：MAVP通过预测共享地图坐标系中的显式基座姿态目标并利用定位反馈进行跟踪，提高了移动操作中基座运动的可靠性，在六个真实世界任务中提升了成功率。

TLDR: MAVP enhances mobile manipulation by predicting explicit base-pose targets in a shared map frame and tracking them with localization feedback, improving execution reliability and task success across six real-world tasks.

Abstract: Successful mobile manipulation requires coordinated base and arm motion while maintaining accurate spatial positioning. However, demonstration-trained policies can struggle to realise the intended base motion reliably, leading to spatial misalignment and subsequent manipulation failures. We present MAVP (Map-Aware Visuomotor Policies), a framework that improves execution reliability by predicting explicit base-pose targets and tracking them using localisation feedback. MAVP reconstructs a static map from teleoperated demonstrations and expresses demonstrated base trajectories in a shared map frame, providing consistent spatial supervision across demonstrations. At execution time, the policy receives RGB observations, joint states, and the robot's current map-frame base pose, and jointly predicts target base poses, arm actions, and gripper actions. A low-level controller tracks the predicted base targets using feedforward motion and pose error feedback, enabling correction of execution deviations. We additionally use pose-noise augmentation during training to improve robustness to errors in the policy's pose input. Across six real-world manipulation tasks and three policy families, MAVP achieves higher task success rates than unanchored velocity control in all tasks. Videos and additional results are available at https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 成功的移动操作要求基座与手臂运动协调一致，同时保持精确的空间定位。然而，基于演示训练的策略往往难以可靠地实现预期的基座运动，导致空间错位，进而引发操作失败。我们提出了MAVP（地图感知视觉运动策略）框架，通过预测明确的基座位姿目标，并利用定位反馈进行跟踪，从而提升执行可靠性。MAVP从遥操作演示中重建静态地图，并将演示的基座轨迹统一表达在共享地图坐标系中，为跨演示提供一致的空间监督。在执行阶段，策略接收RGB图像、关节状态以及机器人当前在地图坐标系中的基座位姿，并联合预测目标基座位姿、手臂动作和夹爪动作。底层控制器利用前馈运动与位姿误差反馈跟踪预测的基座目标，从而修正执行偏差。此外，我们在训练过程中引入位姿噪声增强，以提高对策略位姿输入误差的鲁棒性。在六个真实世界操作任务和三类策略家族中，MAVP在所有任务中的任务成功率均高于未锚定的速度控制方法。视频与更多结果详见 https://123qwedsa123.github.io/mavp/。

Authors: Jinhe Tang, Ruixiao Dai, Weiming Zhi

Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering VLN

Embodied Question Answering Vision-Language Models hierarchical scene graph floorplan priors semantic frontier exploration

简要说明：HFLEX-EQA 是一个分层 EQA 框架，结合在线场景图构建、基于 VLM 的规划、语义前沿探索和平面图先验来指导未知环境中的探索，在 OpenEQA/ExploreEQA 基准和真实四足机器人部署上展示了改进的性能。

TLDR: HFLEX-EQA is a hierarchical EQA framework that combines online scene graph construction, VLM-based planning, semantic frontier exploration, and floorplan priors to guide exploration in unseen environments, demonstrating improved performance on OpenEQA/ExploreEQA benchmarks and real quadruped robot deployment.

Abstract: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires an agent to explore a previously unseen environment, gather relevant information, and answer questions about the scene. Recent approaches leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with semantic maps or scene graphs to guide exploration. However, exploration is typically driven only by local observations, while structural priors about the environment remain largely unused. We propose HFLEX-EQA, a hierarchical EQA framework that combines online scene graph construction, VLM- based planning, semantic frontier exploration, and floorplan priors. The system incrementally builds a hierarchical scene graph and an open-vocabulary occupancy map from RGB-D observations, enabling a VLM to jointly reason over the scene graph, task-relevant visual observations, exploration history, and an estimated topological floorplan. Furthermore, we introduce a room-discovery strategy that leverages the floorplan and open-vocabulary frontier semantics to guide exploration toward semantically relevant yet currently unobserved room types. We evaluate HFLEX-EQA on the OpenEQA and ExploreEQA benchmarks and demonstrate deployment on a quadruped robot in real indoor environments. Our results demonstrate the benefit of combining VLM-based hierarchical planning with structural floorplan priors for the EQA task.

摘要（中文）：具身问答（EQA）要求智能体在未见过的环境中进行探索，收集相关信息并回答关于场景的问题。近期方法通常借助视觉-语言模型（VLMs）并结合语义地图或场景图来引导探索。然而，现有探索策略往往仅由局部观测驱动，环境中关于结构的先验信息在很大程度上未被利用。我们提出了HFLEX-EQA，一种分层EQA框架，结合了在线场景图构建、基于VLM的规划、语义前沿探索以及楼层平面图先验。该系统通过RGB-D观测增量构建分层场景图和开放词汇占用地图，使VLM能够联合推理场景图、任务相关的视觉观测、探索历史以及估计的拓扑楼层平面图。此外，我们引入了一种房间发现策略，利用楼层平面图和开放词汇前沿语义，将探索引导至语义相关但尚未观察到的房间类型。我们在OpenEQA和ExploreEQA基准上评估了HFLEX-EQA，并在真实室内环境中展示了其在四足机器人上的部署。实验结果表明，将基于VLM的分层规划与结构化楼层平面图先验相结合，对EQA任务具有显著优势。

Authors: Albert Gassol Puigjaner, Kostas Alexis

Leveraging Vision-Based Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Online Vectorized HD Mapping AutonomousDriving

camera-based 3D detection vectorized HD mapping point cloud prior map BEV fusion long-term scene memory

简要说明：本文提出了一种无需激光雷达、仅利用过去相机遍历构建静态点云先验地图（结合Pi3X和DINOv3特征），并在BEV中与在线相机特征融合的框架，从而在Argoverse 2上显著提升了基于相机的3D目标检测和在线矢量化高清地图构建性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework that constructs static point cloud prior maps from previous camera traversals (without LiDAR) using Pi3X and DINOv3 features, then fuses local prior patches with online camera features in BEV to improve camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping for autonomous driving, achieving significant gains on Argoverse 2.

Abstract: Camera-based 3D object detection and online vectorized HD mapping provide compact scene representations for autonomous driving, but both depend on accurate metric geometry and remain limited by depth ambiguity. Over long-term deployment, observations from repeated traversals can be accumulated into persistent point cloud priors that provide geometric context beyond the current observations. Existing explicit point cloud prior approaches, however, rely on LiDAR-based map construction and therefore require expensive 3D ranging sensors. We propose a framework that constructs a static point cloud prior map from previous camera traversals using Pi3X and augments each point with DINOv3 features. At runtime, a local prior patch is retrieved using global localization, encoded with a sparse voxel backbone, and fused in bird's-eye view (BEV) with lifted multi-view camera features. Task-specific sparse transformer heads then predict 3D objects and vectorized map elements from the fused representation. On Argoverse 2, the vision-based prior improves a strong baseline from 0.287 to 0.299 CDS and from 0.669 to 0.750 vectorized mapping mAP. Ablations show that semantic DINOv3 features are particularly important for vectorized mapping. These results demonstrate that vision-built geometric-semantic priors provide an effective form of long-term scene memory for camera-based perception, improving both tasks without LiDAR for prior-map construction or online inference.

摘要（中文）：基于相机的三维目标检测与在线矢量化高精地图构建为自动驾驶提供了紧凑的场景表示，但两者均依赖于精确的度量几何，且受限于深度模糊性。在长期部署中，多次往返采集的观测可以累积为持久化的点云先验，为当前观测提供超出其范围的几何上下文。然而，现有的显式点云先验方法依赖基于激光雷达的地图构建，因此需要昂贵的3D测距传感器。我们提出了一种框架，利用Pi3X从过往相机遍历中构建静态点云先验地图，并为每个点增强DINOv3特征。在运行时，通过全局定位检索局部先验块，使用稀疏体素骨干网络进行编码，并与提升至鸟瞰图（BEV）的多视角相机特征进行融合。随后，任务特定的稀疏Transformer头从融合表示中预测3D目标与矢量化地图元素。在Argoverse 2数据集上，基于视觉的先验将强基线的CDS从0.287提升至0.299，将矢量化地图mAP从0.669提升至0.750。消融实验表明，语义DINOv3特征对矢量化地图构建尤为重要。这些结果证明，视觉构建的几何-语义先验为基于相机的感知提供了一种有效的长期场景记忆形式，且无需激光雷达即可完成先验地图构建或在线推理，同时提升了两个任务的表现。

Authors: Markus Käppeler, Rohit Mohan, Abhinav Valada

TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models WorldModel

tri-view consistency embodied world models bimanual manipulation benchmark multi-camera evaluation

简要说明：提出了TRIWORLDBENCH，一个用于评估具身世界模型的基准，通过同步头部和手腕摄像头的三视角一致性进行评估，包含500个片段和19个指标。

TLDR: Introduces TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models by assessing tri-view consistency across synchronized head and wrist cameras, with 500 episodes and 19 metrics.

Abstract: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.

摘要（中文）：具身世界模型通过预测机器人动作的结果来支持学习与规划。对于配备头部摄像头和腕部摄像头的机器人，这需要互补的视角：头部视角捕捉整体任务，而腕部视角则揭示局部夹爪与物体的交互。然而，独立评估这些视角无法确定它们是否描述相同的动作和物体状态。我们提出了TRIWORLDBENCH，一个通过同步头部、左腕和右腕视频来评估具身世界模型的基准。该基准包含50个双臂操作任务中的500个片段，并使用19项指标来评估三视角一致性、任务对齐、物理与三维连贯性、运动质量、时间一致性和视觉质量。通过将跨视角检查与针对每个摄像头量身定制的测量相结合，该基准评估了各个看似合理的视频是否也能形成对预期任务的一致性预测。我们使用TWB分数汇总整体性能，并保留各视角的结果以识别预测失败之处。这将世界模型的评估扩展到了单视角视觉质量之外。代码、数据和指标定义可在 https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench 获取。

Authors: Xuanyi Liu, Haofeng Wang, Ruiqi Li, Danni Yu, Rui Wan, Ruixu Zhang, Siyu Tao, Xue Yang, Shaofeng Zhang, Zicheng Zhang, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma

SafeLoop: Risk-Aware Rollback for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action risk-aware rollback hazard prediction manipulation safety

简要说明：SafeLoop 是一个非侵入式的外部包装器，通过风险预测和基于回滚的恢复机制，在不改变 VLA 模型参数的情况下，将 LIBERO 基准和真实机器人任务中的危险情况减少约 70%，同时保持任务成功率。

TLDR: SafeLoop is a non-invasive external wrapper that adds a risk predictor and rollback-based recovery to VLA models, reducing hazard cases by roughly 70% while preserving task success across LIBERO benchmarks and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for general-purpose manipulation, but long-horizon execution remains fragile. Small state-estimation or control errors can lead to irreversible failures (e.g., collisions and object drops). Avoiding these risks requires a proactive safety mechanism capable of anticipating hazards. In this paper, we introduce SafeLoop, a non-invasive external wrapper that adds hazard prediction and rollback-based recovery to a VLA model without changing its parameters. SafeLoop trains a risk predictor from vision and proprioception to output four values: the probability and time-to-hazard for body collisions and for object failures. A lightweight controller then chooses one of three actions based on the predicted risk: continue execution (noop), save a safety checkpoint (record), or retreat in joint space (rollback). Rollback moves the robot back to a recent safe waypoint and queries the base policy again, which may yield an alternative continuation. Across 24 LIBERO tasks (16 random seeds each) and three real-robot tasks (25 rollouts each), SafeLoop achieves a stronger overall safety-success trade-off than alternative methods, reducing hazard cases by roughly 70% while preserving task success and the base-policy control rate. Project code is available at https://github.com/Loule0-0/SafeLoop/tree/release/safeloop.

摘要（中文）：近期提出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用操作任务中展现出巨大潜力，但长时程执行仍较为脆弱。微小的状态估计或控制误差可能导致不可逆的失败（例如碰撞和物体掉落）。为规避这些风险，需要一种能够提前预判危险的前瞻性安全机制。本文提出SafeLoop，一种非侵入式外部包装器，在不修改VLA模型参数的前提下，为其增加危险预测与基于回滚的恢复能力。SafeLoop利用视觉和本体感觉信息训练一个风险预测器，输出四个指标：身体碰撞发生概率及时间、物体失效发生概率及时间。随后，一个轻量级控制器根据预测风险从三种动作中选择其一：继续执行（无操作）、保存安全检查点（记录）、或在关节空间内回退（回滚）。回滚操作将机器人退回至最近的安全路点，并重新调用基础策略，可能生成一条替代的后续轨迹。在24个LIBERO任务（每个任务16个随机种子）和三个真实机器人任务（每个任务25次试验）中，SafeLoop在整体安全性和任务成功率的权衡上优于对比方法，危险情形减少约70%，同时保持任务成功率及基础策略控制率。项目代码已发布于 https://github.com/Loule0-0/SafeLoop/tree/release/safeloop。

Authors: Zeyu Lou, Tianran Zhang, Xinquan Yue, Ya Jing, Chenyang Si

RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World? Manipulation

physics-diverse benchmark robot manipulation robustness physical-condition diversity expert demonstrations

简要说明：本文提出了RoboTwin-Phys，一个机器人操作领域的物理多样性基准，通过改变13种物理属性并提供专家演示，来评估和提升世界模型和VLA模型对物理条件变化的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces RoboTwin-Phys, a physics-diverse benchmark for robot manipulation that varies 13 physical attributes and provides expert demonstrations to evaluate and improve robustness of WAMs and VLAs to physical-condition diversity.

Abstract: Physical-condition diversity is largely missing from current benchmarks for robot manipulation. While large-scale simulation benchmarks increasingly incorporate variations in object appearance, scene layout, and visual observations, they typically keep the underlying physical parameters fixed. As a result, important sources of real-world variability, such as changes in mass, friction, and joint dynamics, remain largely untested. We introduce RoboTwin-Phys, a physics-diverse benchmark that treats physical-condition diversity as an explicit dimension of robot manipulation evaluation. The benchmark continuously varies 13 physical attributes within physically plausible ranges, providing a unified setting for evaluating policies across diverse physical operating conditions. We further release more than 5,000 expert demonstrations with ground-truth physical parameters, enabling physical-attribute estimation, condition-aware modeling, and physics-conditioned policy training. Evaluations of representative WAMs and VLAs reveal a substantial robustness gap: models that remain effective under existing visual and layout randomization can degrade markedly under changes in physical conditions. RoboTwin-Phys provides the benchmark, data, and evaluation protocol needed to systematically measure and improve robustness to physical-condition diversity in robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：物理条件多样性在当前的机器人操作基准测试中基本缺失。尽管大规模仿真基准日益纳入物体外观、场景布局和视觉观测的多样性，但它们通常保持底层物理参数固定不变。因此，质量、摩擦力和关节动力学等真实世界变异的重要来源在很大程度上仍未得到测试。我们提出了RoboTwin-Phys，这是一个以物理条件多样性作为机器人操作评估显式维度的物理多样性基准。该基准在物理合理的范围内连续变化13个物理属性，为在多样物理操作条件下评估策略提供了统一框架。我们进一步发布了包含真实物理参数的5000多条专家演示数据，支持物理属性估计、条件感知建模以及物理条件策略训练。对代表性WAM和VLA的评估揭示了一个显著的鲁棒性差距：在现有视觉和布局随机化下仍然有效的模型，在物理条件变化下性能可能显著下降。RoboTwin-Phys提供了系统测量和提升机器人操作中物理条件多样性鲁棒性所需的基准、数据和评估协议。

Authors: Jiaqi Zhang, Feng Ye, Mingjia Yang, Zhihong Chen, Mingkang Xiang, Xinglin Yao, Yanbin Li, Siwei Ma, Chuanmin Jia

Predict Before You Step: Auditable Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance under Sparse Guidance Locomotion

occupancy forecasting legged robot obstacle avoidance recurrent predictor sparse waypoint guidance

简要说明：LOOP 是一种 50 Hz 的腿部机器人局部避障策略，通过潜在循环流动和可见性门控预测未来 1 秒的占据地图，并基于这些地图在稀疏航点引导下选择速度。在仿真中优于反应式和 BEV 基线，并在 Unitree Go2 上完成全部 16 次真实穿越试验而无一碰撞。

TLDR: LOOP is a 50 Hz local avoidance policy for legged robots that forecasts occupancy over 1 s via latent-recurrent flow and visibility gates, using these maps to select velocities under sparse waypoint guidance. It outperforms reactive and BEV baselines in simulation and completes all 16 real-world crossing trials on a Unitree Go2 without collision.

Abstract: Legged robots under sparse waypoint guidance must avoid moving obstacles using partial, rapidly changing LiDAR observations. We present LOOP (Latent-recurrent Occupancy rollOut Policy), a local avoidance policy that connects sparse waypoint guidance to a frozen locomotion controller at 50 Hz. From occupancy and ego-velocity histories, a recurrent predictor forecasts future occupancy over a 1 s horizon by warping the current map with learned flow and visibility gates. These maps guide velocity selection through map-derived features and geometric risk estimates, providing an explicit interface for inspecting and replacing predictions. In encounter-synchronised Isaac Lab evaluations, LOOP achieves 57.1% head-on success at obstacle speeds of 2.5-3.2 m/s, exceeding a retrained reactive baseline by 8.2 percentage points. Comparisons with a rollout-free BEV policy show smaller, scenario-dependent gains from the prediction branch, including improved crossing success and reduced variability across training seeds at the highest head-on speeds. The adapter runs onboard a Unitree Go2 in 14.5 ms per step and completes all 16 real-world crossing trials without collision, demonstrating deployment feasibility.

摘要（中文）：在稀疏航点引导下，腿式机器人必须利用部分且快速变化的激光雷达观测来避开移动障碍物。我们提出了LOOP（潜在递归占用率滚出策略），一种局部避障策略，它以50赫兹的频率将稀疏航点引导与冻结的运动控制器相连接。基于占用率和自身速度的历史数据，递归预测器通过将当前地图与学习到的流和可见性门控进行扭曲，预测未来1秒范围内的占用率。这些地图通过地图派生特征和几何风险估计引导速度选择，为检查和替换预测提供了显式接口。在相遇同步的Isaac Lab评估中，LOOP在障碍物速度2.5-3.2米/秒的情况下实现了57.1%的正面相遇成功率，比重训练的反应式基线高出8.2个百分点。与无滚出的BEV策略相比，预测分支带来的收益较小且依赖于场景，包括在最高正面速度下穿越成功率的提升以及跨训练种子变异性的降低。该适配器在Unitree Go2机载上每步运行14.5毫秒，并完成全部16次真实世界穿越试验而无碰撞，证明了部署的可行性。

Authors: Yuhui Mao, Fen Liu, Shenghai Yuan, Tianxin Hu, Ruimeng Liu, Rong Su

An Action Is Worth One Patch: Unified World-Action Modeling with PatchWAM VLA

Action-as-Patch unified world-action model generative backbone robotic manipulation visual prediction

简要说明：PatchWAM 通过将连续动作视为一种特殊的 patch token，在单个生成模型中统一了视觉预测与动作生成，无需单独的动作头或专家，并在机器人操作基准上取得了优异成功率。

TLDR: PatchWAM unifies visual prediction and action generation in a single generative model by treating continuous actions as patch tokens via a fixed mapping, eliminating the need for separate action heads or experts and achieving strong success rates on robotic manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Generative visual models offer a foundation for learning representations of physical dynamics, yet their extension to continuous control raises a fundamental question: do visual prediction and action generation require separate computational pathways? Existing approaches usually introduce trainable action heads or separate action experts to bridge low-dimensional states and high-dimensional visual representations. In this work, we explore whether the visual backbone's existing capacity can also support control when actions are expressed in a compatible representation. Thus, we introduce PatchWAM (Patch World-Action Model), which treats continuous actions as another type of patch through a fixed mapping called Action-as-Patch. This allows a single model to predict both how the robot should move and what the scene may look like afterward. Visual prediction and action generation become parts of the same generative process, without a dedicated action head or separate action expert. Experiments with subsampled training windows show gains over a matched dual-expert control, while benchmark evaluations reach 91.8% success rate on LIBERO-Plus and 96.12% on RoboTwin 2.0 in a full-data setting with additional augmented demonstrations. More broadly, the result suggests that capability need not be added where it can be inherited: the constraint on extending a generative backbone is the interface a new signal is written in, not the capacity to model it.

摘要（中文）：生成式视觉模型为学习物理动力学的表征提供了基础，然而将其扩展到连续控制领域引发了一个根本性问题：视觉预测与动作生成是否需要各自独立的计算通路？现有方法通常引入可训练的动作头或独立的动作专家，以桥接低维状态与高维视觉表征之间的鸿沟。在本研究中，我们探讨当动作用一种兼容的表征形式表达时，视觉骨干网络已有的能力是否同样能够支撑控制任务。为此，我们提出了PatchWAM（Patch World-Action Model，补丁世界-动作模型），通过一种名为“动作即补丁”（Action-as-Patch）的固定映射，将连续动作视为另一种类型的补丁。这使得单一模型能够同时预测机器人应如何移动以及场景随后可能呈现的状态。视觉预测与动作生成成为同一生成过程中的组成部分，无需专门的动作头或独立的动作专家。在子采样训练窗口上的实验表明，该模型优于匹配的双专家控制方法；同时，在完整数据设置并辅以额外增强演示的条件下，基准评估在LIBERO-Plus上达到了91.8%的成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到了96.12%。更广泛地看，这一结果表明，能力无需在可继承之处另行添加：对生成式骨干网络进行扩展的约束在于新信号所采用的接口形式，而非建模该信号的能力本身。

Authors: Tianheng Wang, Zhou Xie, Heng Jia, Jianhua Xu, Tong Zhang, Kaicheng Yu

MatchFusion: Explicit-Implicit Instance Matching for Spatio-Temporal Multimodal Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

instance matching multimodal fusion spatio-temporal LiDAR-camera E2EAD

简要说明：MatchFusion 提出了一种可学习的实例匹配与融合模块，结合几何/结构先验与上下文嵌入，实现自动驾驶中高效准确的空间-时间 LiDAR-相机交互，在 nuScenes 实验中获得一致的感知提升并降低计算量。

TLDR: MatchFusion proposes a learnable instance matching and fusion module that combines geometric/structural priors with contextual embeddings for efficient and accurate spatio-temporal LiDAR-camera interaction in autonomous driving, yielding consistent perception gains and reduced compute in nuScenes experiments.

Abstract: Sparse instance representations provide a compact interface for spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction in multimodal perception and E2EAD. Effective interaction requires reliable instance correspondences despite geometric discrepancies and heterogeneous semantic representations. Attention-based methods exploit contextual semantics but often require specialized representation alignment, increasing computational overhead. In contrast, association based on structured object states is efficient and interpretable but lacks contextual evidence to resolve ambiguous matches. To combine these complementary strengths, we propose MatchFusion, a learnable instance matching and fusion module for spatio-temporal multimodal autonomous driving. MatchFusion initializes pairwise affinities using geometric similarity and category consistency, then selectively refines structurally plausible associations using instance embeddings. The resulting soft matchmap guides a common residual aggregation operator for adaptive information exchange. This unified matching-fusion formulation supports spatial LiDAR-camera and temporal past-current interaction, using multi-view image-plane geometry and motion-compensated BEV geometry as the respective structural priors. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate consistent perception gains across diverse front-end configurations. Compared with a prior instance-centric fusion method, the MatchFusion-equipped system achieves higher perception accuracy while reducing FLOPs by 55.3% and GPU memory usage by 39.3%, with the matching-fusion module accounting for only 3.7% of total perception latency. Integrating temporal MatchFusion into SparseDrive further improves perception within an E2E framework without additional supervision. These results establish explicit-implicit matching as an effective and efficient mechanism for spatio-temporal instance interaction.

摘要（中文）：稀疏实例表示为多模态感知和端到端自动驾驶（E2EAD）中的空间激光雷达-相机交互及时间上过去-当前交互提供了紧凑的接口。有效的交互需要在几何差异和异构语义表示下建立可靠的实例对应关系。基于注意力机制的方法利用上下文语义，但通常需要专门的表示对齐，从而增加计算开销。相比之下，基于结构化对象状态的关联方法高效且可解释，但缺乏解决模糊匹配所需的上下文证据。为结合这两种互补优势，我们提出了MatchFusion——一种用于时空多模态自动驾驶的可学习实例匹配与融合模块。MatchFusion首先利用几何相似性和类别一致性初始化成对亲和度，然后使用实例嵌入选择性细化结构上合理的关联。所得的软匹配图引导统一的残差聚合算子进行自适应信息交换。该统一的匹配-融合框架支持空间激光雷达-相机交互和时间上过去-当前交互，分别采用多视图图像平面几何和运动补偿鸟瞰图（BEV）几何作为相应的结构先验。在nuScenes上的实验表明，该方法在不同前端配置下均能获得一致的感知性能提升。与先前的实例中心融合方法相比，配备MatchFusion的系统实现了更高的感知精度，同时将FLOPs降低55.3%，GPU内存使用降低39.3%，且匹配-融合模块仅占总体感知延迟的3.7%。将时间MatchFusion集成到SparseDrive中，可在端到端框架内无需额外监督地进一步提升感知性能。这些结果证实了显式-隐式匹配作为时空实例交互的一种有效且高效的机制。

Authors: Xiaoyu Li, Jiajia Fu, Long Shi, Tianyu Du, Ruihang Li, Xian Wu, Lijun Zhao, Yingtao Zhang, Lining Sun, Ruifeng Li

Sometimes You Gotta Run Before You Can Walk: Run-then-Walk Scheduling Strategy for VLM Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

VLM autonomous driving GRPO reinforcement learning reward scheduling driving safety efficiency

简要说明：本文提出了一种名为Run-then-Walk的两阶段奖励调度策略，用于VLM自动驾驶规划器的GRPO强化学习，通过分离进度发现与安全修复，在减少40-50%训练轮次的同时提升驾驶性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a two-stage reward scheduling strategy called Run-then-Walk for GRPO-based reinforcement learning in VLM autonomous driving planners, which separates progress discovery from safety repair to achieve better driving performance with 40-50% fewer training epochs.

Abstract: Recent VLM-based autonomous driving planners adopt GRPO-style reinforcement learning to optimize driving performance. However, existing GRPO recipes either optimize driving efficiency, risking progress-seeking but unsafe behavior, or enforce early safety constraints, leading to overly conservative behavior; both require lengthy training. To solve these problems, we first reveal two distinct RL regimes: a progress regime (Run-GRPO) that aggressively explores high progress, and a safety regime (Walk-GRPO) that restores safety under stable progress. Based on this finding, we propose $\textit{Run-then-Walk}$, a simple yet effective two-stage reward scheduling strategy for GRPO, achieving both better performance and faster convergence. Unlike one-stage RL, which may focus on progress, safety, or a mixture of both within a single training phase, this schedule explicitly separates progress discovery from safety repair. In the $\textit{Run}$ phase, we focus on progress, allowing the policy to escape the conservative bias and discover high-progress modes. In the subsequent $\textit{Walk}$ phase, we introduce endpoint and safety strategy to repair unsafe behaviors from the Run phase. This reversed schedule overcomes the conservatism of Walk-first methods and the unsafe progress-seeking of joint optimization. We validate it with various VLM-based planners on multiple benchmarks: NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, Navhard, and nuScenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved driving performance while requiring 40--50\% fewer RL training epochs than the baselines.

摘要（中文）：近期基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自动驾驶规划器采用GRPO风格强化学习来优化驾驶性能。然而，现有的GRPO方案要么侧重于优化驾驶效率，从而可能引发追求进度但不够安全的行为；要么过早施加安全约束，导致决策过于保守，两者均需较长的训练时间。为解决上述问题，我们首先揭示了两种截然不同的强化学习模式：一种为进度模式（Run-GRPO），其积极探索高进度；另一种为安全模式（Walk-GRPO），在进度稳定的前提下恢复安全性。基于这一发现，我们提出了“先跑后走”（Run-then-Walk）策略——一种简单而有效的两阶段奖励调度方案，用于GRPO，兼顾更优性能与更快收敛。与单阶段强化学习可能在同一训练阶段中侧重进度、安全或两者混合不同，本方案明确将进度发现与安全修复分离开来。在“跑”（Run）阶段，我们聚焦于进度，使策略能够摆脱保守偏差，发现高进度模式。在随后的“走”（Walk）阶段，我们引入终点约束与安全策略，以修复在“跑”阶段产生的不安全行为。这一逆序调度克服了先走法（Walk-first）的保守主义以及联合优化中不安全地追求进度的问题。我们基于多种VLM规划器，在多个基准数据集（NAVSIMv1、NAVSIMv2、Navhard和nuScenes）上对该方案进行了验证。大量实验表明，所提方法在提升驾驶性能的同时，相较于基线方法，所需的强化学习训练周期减少了40%至50%。

Authors: Yuqi Ye, Shangkun Sun, Junhong Lin, Jiayi Zhao, Changhao Peng, Wei Zheng, Guoqing Liu, Tiesong Zhao, Wei Gao

Beyond Reconstruction Error: Analytical and Data-Driven Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

action tokenization vision-language-action models closed-loop control LIBERO reconstruction error

简要说明：本文比较了自回归VLA模型中解析、数据驱动线性和非线性动作分词方法，表明仅凭重构误差不足以选择表示，需联合评估几何保真度、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性和闭环性能（LIBERO）。

TLDR: This paper compares analytical, data-driven linear, and nonlinear action tokenizations for autoregressive VLA models, showing reconstruction error alone is insufficient for selecting representations and advocating joint evaluation of fidelity, predictability, stability, and closed-loop performance via LIBERO rollouts.

Abstract: Discrete action tokenization is central to autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet action representations are often evaluated primarily through reconstruction fidelity. We ask which representation properties actually matter for closed-loop control by comparing fixed analytical, data-driven linear, and nonlinear neural representations under a unified tokenization interface. Across rate-distortion analysis, sequence-modeling diagnostics, and 3,500 LIBERO rollouts, representation rankings change with the evaluation criterion. PCA achieves lower nominal reconstruction error than Temporal-DCT, but produces less predictable token sequences and 3.0 percentage points lower mean seen-task success across three policy-training seeds, with the policy ordering reversing in one seed. In a matched seed-42 ablation, an autoencoder further reduces reconstruction error yet does not yield the strongest policy and exhibits greater sensitivity to discrete token perturbations. These findings show that reconstruction fidelity alone cannot reliably select action representations for autoregressive control, motivating joint evaluation of geometric fidelity, sequence predictability, decoder stability, and closed-loop performance.

摘要（中文）：离散动作标记化是自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的核心，然而动作表示通常主要依据重建保真度进行评估。我们提出疑问：在统一的标记化接口下，通过比较固定解析表示、数据驱动的线性表示以及非线性神经表示，究竟哪些表示属性对闭环控制真正重要。在率失真分析、序列建模诊断以及3500次LIBERO rollout测试中，表示排名随评估标准的变化而变化。PCA相比时间域DCT实现了更低的标称重建误差，但在三个策略训练种子上产生了可预测性较低的标记序列，平均已见任务成功率低3.0个百分点，且在一个种子中策略排序发生反转。在匹配的seed-42消融实验中，自编码器进一步降低了重建误差，但并未产生最强的策略，并且对离散标记扰动表现出更高的敏感性。这些研究结果表明，仅凭重建保真度无法可靠地为自回归控制选择动作表示，因此有必要对几何保真度、序列可预测性、解码器稳定性以及闭环性能进行联合评估。

Authors: Yuxin Yang, Gaohan He, Changxue Guan, Hangming Liu

VisForce: Visual Grounding of Current and Desired Forces for Goal-Conditioned Dexterous Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action model dexterous manipulation force grounding goal-conditioned real robot

简要说明：VisForce将当前力和目标力可视化地映射到指尖位置，通过目标条件交叉注意力生成力感知动作，并在真实机器人灵巧操作任务中展示了更好的抓取力响应和成功率。

TLDR: VisForce visually grounds current and desired forces at fingertip locations in wrist and goal images, enabling force-aware actions for VLA-based dexterous manipulation, and demonstrates improved grip-force response and success rates on real robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as general-purpose robotic manipulation policies. However, in dexterous hand manipulation, contact forces are typically provided as separate states or force-specific representations, making it difficult to explicitly represent the spatial correspondence between force and their corresponding visual locations. In this work, we propose VisForce, which visually grounds the current and desired forces at their corresponding fingertip locations. VisForce renders current and desired visual force cues on the current wrist image and a task-specific goal image, and combines the two representations through goal-conditioned cross-attention to generate force-aware actions. We evaluate VisForce using a real UR10 robot equipped with an RH56F1 dexterous hand through force-conditioned grasping and three multi-stage manipulation tasks. In force-conditioned grasping experiments, VisForce exhibited a consistent grip-force response as the desired force increased, and achieved grasp-and-lift success rates of 70% and 80% for an egg and a toothpaste tube, respectively. It further achieved final success rates of 70%, 55%, and 40% on cup insertion/bottle pouring, tong-assisted bread transfer, and slip-modulated peg-in-hole, respectively. These results show that fingertip-aligned visual force representations can be effectively used for force-aware conditioning in VLA-based dexterous hand manipulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为通用的机器人操作策略。然而，在灵巧手操作中，接触力通常以独立状态或特定力表征的形式提供，难以显式表达力与其对应视觉位置之间的空间对应关系。在本工作中，我们提出VisForce，该方法将当前力和目标力在视觉上锚定到对应的指尖位置。VisForce将当前力与目标力的视觉提示分别渲染在当前腕部图像和任务特定目标图像上，并通过目标条件交叉注意力融合两种表征，以生成力感知动作。我们使用配备RH56F1灵巧手的真实UR10机器人，通过力条件抓取和三项多阶段操作任务对VisForce进行评估。在力条件抓取实验中，VisForce随目标力增加表现出一致的抓取力响应，并在鸡蛋和牙膏管抓取提升任务中分别实现了70%和80%的成功率。在杯体插入/倒瓶、镊助面包转移和滑移调节的销孔插入任务中，VisForce分别达到了70%、55%和40%的最终成功率。这些结果表明，指尖对齐的视觉力表征可有效用于基于VLA的灵巧手操作中的力感知条件控制。

Authors: Jung-Woo Lee, Soo-Chul Lim

MedVLA: A Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Framework for Closed-Loop Precision Medical Robot Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action closed-loop medical robot function-constrained execution chain-of-thought data multi-agent pipeline

简要说明：MedVLA 提出了一种分层视觉-语言-动作框架，将高层推理与低层功能约束执行分离，在柔性电极植入实验中达到 95% 的成功率，优于 OpenVLA 和 π0。

TLDR: MedVLA proposes a hierarchical Vision-Language-Action framework that separates high-level reasoning from function-constrained low-level execution for precision medical robotics, achieving a 95% success rate in flexible electrode implantation trials, outperforming OpenVLA and π0.

Abstract: Precision medical robotics demands adaptive decision-making under strict safety, interpretability, and execution constraints. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show strong multimodal reasoning ability, their continuous action generation paradigm is not well suited for precision medical tasks, where reliable closed-loop operation may also depend on non-action system function calls. To address this gap, we propose MedVLA, a hierarchical framework that couples high-level multimodal reasoning with low-level function-constrained execution. We further introduce a scalable multi-agent pipeline to generate skill-oriented chain-of-thought(CoT) data for structured training. Built on different multimodal large-model backbones, MedVLA consistently improves performance after fine-tuning, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework across model variants. Under identical initial conditions, we perform 100 closed-loop flexible electrode implantation trials. The results show that MedVLA achieves a 95.0\% task success rate, substantially outperforming representative VLA baselines, including OpenVLA (8\%) and $π_0$ (15\%), in accuracy, stability, and safety. These results indicate that structured reasoning with constrained function-level execution is a practical route toward deployable precision medical robotics.

摘要（中文）：精准医疗机器人要求在严格的安全性、可解释性和执行约束下具备自适应的决策能力。尽管近期提出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出强大的多模态推理能力，但其连续动作生成范式并不适用于精准医疗任务，在这类任务中，可靠的闭环运行往往还依赖于非动作类系统函数调用。为弥补这一不足，我们提出MedVLA，一种将高层多模态推理与低层函数约束执行相结合的分层框架。此外，我们引入了一种可扩展的多智能体流水线，用于生成面向技能的思维链（CoT）数据以支持结构化训练。基于不同的多模态大模型骨干网络，MedVLA在微调后均能持续提升性能，验证了所提框架在不同模型变体上的有效性。在完全相同的初始条件下，我们开展了100次闭环柔性电极植入试验。结果表明，MedVLA的任务成功率达到95.0%，在准确性、稳定性和安全性方面均显著优于具有代表性的VLA基线模型，包括OpenVLA（8%）和π₀（15%）。上述结果表明，将结构化推理与受约束的函数级执行相结合，是实现可部署精准医疗机器人的一条可行路径。

Authors: Junjie Xie, Chuxuan He, Angen Ye, Yujia Song, Dapeng Zhang

Fisheye-VLA: Decoupling Coverage and Acuity for Manipulation with a Single Fisheye Camera VLA

fisheye camera end-effector-centered crops ray encoding pretrained VLA manipulation

简要说明：Fisheye-VLA 提出了一种使用单个鱼眼相机的视觉接口，结合全局视图和基于末端执行器的局部裁剪及共享射线编码，集成预训练VLA，在扩展桌面、货架和传送带场景中实现了高成功率，无需腕部相机。

TLDR: Fisheye-VLA proposes a single fisheye camera visual interface for robot manipulation, using global views and calibrated end-effector-centered local crops with shared ray encoding, integrated with a pretrained VLA to achieve high success in expanded tabletop, shelf, and conveyor scenarios without wrist cameras.

Abstract: Manipulation requires both broad scene awareness and detailed local feedback, yet conventional camera rigs provide them through separate front and wrist cameras. We present Fisheye-VLA, a visual interface that brings these capabilities together using a single passive fisheye. A global view preserves the workspace, while local perspective crops direct detail toward the interaction. The key design question is where this local visual budget should go. We answer it through a controlled re-rendering study, comparing alternative crop directions on the same recorded observations. The study finds that end-effector-centered views capture most of the estimated benefit of a much larger candidate pool, motivating a compact allocation around both hands. Our interface uses calibrated end-effector projection and motion lead to track the crops, while a shared ray encoding preserves their spatial meaning as they move. Integrated with a pretrained VLA, it achieves 84% and 82% success in the two expanded tabletop regions, where some target placements extend beyond the front-camera coverage, and supports shelf and conveyor manipulation. Ablations show that local crops and their viewing directions become more important in the larger workspace regions. The results demonstrate that a single fisheye can support these manipulation tasks without physical wrist cameras.

摘要（中文）：操纵既需要对场景的广泛感知，也需要对局部细节的精准反馈，然而传统相机装置通过前置相机和腕部相机分别提供这两种能力。我们提出Fisheye-VLA，一种利用单个被动式鱼眼相机将这两者融为一体的视觉接口。全局视图保留工作空间，而局部透视裁剪则将细节直接引向交互区域。关键的设计问题在于，这一局部视觉预算应当投向何处。我们通过一项受控的重新渲染研究来回答这一问题，在相同的记录观测数据上比较不同裁剪方向的效果。研究发现，以末端执行器为中心的视图能够捕获更大候选池中估计收益的大部分，这促使我们围绕双手进行紧凑的分配。我们的接口利用校准的末端执行器投影和运动引导来跟踪裁剪区域，同时通过共享的光线编码在裁剪区域移动时保留其空间语义。与预训练的VLA集成后，该方法在两个扩展的桌面区域中分别取得了84%和82%的成功率，其中部分目标放置位置超出了前置相机的覆盖范围，并能支持货架和传送带上的操纵任务。消融实验表明，在更大的工作空间区域中，局部裁剪及其观察方向变得更加重要。研究结果表明，单个鱼眼相机即可支撑这些操纵任务，而无需物理腕部相机。

Authors: Ziang Ren, Zike Yan, Raymond Zhang, Xuguo He, Zhongyu Li

SG-CPG: Severity-Gated Central Pattern Generators for Adaptive Quadruped Locomotion under Continuous Actuator Degradation Locomotion

Central Pattern Generator Quadruped Locomotion Actuator Degradation Severity-Gated Adaptation Unitree Go2

简要说明：SG-CPG 提出了一种严重程度门控的中央模式生成器，在保留健康运动策略的基础上，通过残差门和幅度门自适应四足机器人在连续执行器退化下的行走，并在 Unitree Go2 真机上验证了鲁棒性。

TLDR: SG-CPG proposes a severity-gated central pattern generator that preserves a frozen healthy locomotion policy and adds residual and amplitude gates to adapt quadruped walking under continuous actuator degradation, demonstrating robust trot gait with real-robot trials on a Unitree Go2.

Abstract: An animal with a weakened limb does not necessarily switch its gait, instead it unloads the affected limb, re-coordinates the remaining limbs, and scales its response with injury severity. This graded adaptation allows locomotion to persist despite partial loss of limb strength, rather than requiring a discrete transition between healthy and failed. Inspired by this behavior, we propose SG-CPG, a central pattern generator (CPG) for quadruped locomotion under continuous actuator degradation. SG-CPG preserves a frozen healthy CPG policy and introduces two severity-driven gates: a residual gate that re-coordinates all four legs and an amplitude gate that progressively shortens the weakened leg's stride as degradation increases. We emulate progressive degradation through two mechanisms: lowering the joint torque ceiling (ceiling mechanism) and scaling its low-level controller gains (gain mechanism), representing distinct forms of actuator weakening. Our simulations on a Unitree Go2 show that SG-CPG maintains a trot gait with 100% survival across an omnidirectional command schedule under 95% joint strength loss while tracking commands within 8%. Under a lowered torque ceiling, removing either severity path, the residual's severity observation or the amplitude gate, raises clipping at the weakened joint from 4.4% to 13.6% and 26.3% of steps at an 80% loss. On a real Go2, SG-CPG survives 28 of 29 forward and turning trials with up to 93% calf torque degradation. These results show that severity-gated adaptation can extend a healthy locomotion policy to progressive actuator degradation without treating the fault as a discrete failure.

摘要（中文）：肢体功能减弱的动物不一定会切换其步态，而是会卸载受影响肢体、重新协调其余肢体，并根据损伤严重程度缩放其响应。这种分级适应机制使得运动在肢体力量部分丧失的情况下仍能持续，而无需在健康与失效之间进行离散切换。受此行为启发，我们提出了SG-CPG，一种针对连续执行器退化场景下四足运动的中央模式生成器（CPG）。SG-CPG保留了一个冻结的健康CPG策略，并引入两个由严重程度驱动的门控：一个残余门控，用于重新协调所有四条腿；一个幅度门控，用于随退化加剧逐步缩短弱化腿的步幅。我们通过两种机制模拟渐进退化：降低关节力矩上限（上限机制）和缩放其底层控制器增益（增益机制），分别代表不同类型的执行器弱化。在Unitree Go2上的仿真表明，SG-CPG在关节力量损失达95%的情况下，仍能在全向指令调度中保持小跑步态，存活率达100%，同时指令跟踪误差在8%以内。在力矩上限降低的情况下，移除任一严重程度路径（残余门的严重程度观测或幅度门控），在80%损失时，弱化关节的截断步数占比将从4.4%分别上升至13.6%和26.3%。在真实Go2平台上，SG-CPG在29次前进和转向试验中成功存活28次，且小腿力矩退化最高达93%。这些结果表明，基于严重程度门控的适应机制可以将健康运动策略扩展至渐进式执行器退化场景，而无需将故障视为离散失效事件。
