Authors: Hang Yang, Tingcong Liu, Junjie Xiong, Fangju Yang, Ke Wu

CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image Perception3D

scene completion RGB-D 3D grounding object decomposition cluttered scenes

简要说明：CODA 是一个生成模型，从单张未分割的RGB-D图像中完成场景几何重建，并将其分解为环境和可移动物体，利用显式3D接地减少漂移，提高杂乱场景中的重建精度和物体稳定性。

TLDR: CODA is a generative model that completes scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image and decomposes it into the environment and movable objects, using explicit 3D grounding to reduce drift, improving reconstruction and object stability for robots in cluttered scenes.

Abstract: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene dataset show more accurate reconstructions and a higher fraction of objects remaining in place under simulated gravity than both object-first and scene-first baselines.

摘要（中文）：机器人在杂乱日常环境中安全操作时，往往需要从部分观察中推断场景几何结构。在二维图像中检测物体并独立重建的方法在此类场景中表现不佳：漏检的物体永远无法被重建，合并的检测可能将两个物体融合为一体，而分别重建的网格可能相互重叠或未能与其支撑表面接触。我们提出了CODA（先完成，后分解），这是一种生成模型，能够从单张未分割的RGB-D图像中重建完整的场景几何结构，然后将表面分为周围环境和可移动物体两部分。然而，生成的场景几何结构可能偏离观察到的部分点云。为减少这种偏移，CODA采用两种显式三维接地机制，在保持重建几何结构与观察表面一致的同时，完成未见区域的补全。在HomebrewedDB及我们自建的杂乱场景数据集上的实验表明，与先物体后场景及先场景后物体的基线方法相比，CODA实现了更精确的重建，并且在模拟重力作用下，物体保持在原位上的比例更高。

Authors: Dongwon Son, Junhyek Han, Yoontae Cho, Minseok Lee, Hong-seok Choi, Jiwook Choi, Hyungjin Kim, Beomjoon Kim

Skill Sequence Planning for Collaborative Multi-Robot Construction Manipulation

skill sequence planning multi-robot construction construction relationship graph symbolic planning digital twin

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于协作多机器人建造的技能序列规划方法，该方法通过中央控制器将建筑数字表示转换为建造关系图，为异构机器人团队生成符号技能序列，并生成无碰撞运动计划，同时提供交互式数字孪生以供人类审查。

TLDR: This paper presents a skill sequence planning method for collaborative multi-robot construction, using a central controller that converts building digital representations into a construction relationship graph, generates symbolic skill sequences for heterogeneous robot teams, and produces collision-free motion plans, with an interactive digital twin for human review.

Abstract: Robots have significant potential to automate construction processes. However, their industry adoption remains limited, partly because of the programming effort required to adapt robots to diverse tasks. This paper presents a skill sequence planning method that enables a heterogeneous team of multi-functional robots to collaboratively perform construction assembly work using reusable, preprogrammed skills such as grasping, drilling, and fastening. A central controller transforms the digital representation of the building into a construction relationship graph that represents construction entities, their states, and their parent-child relationships. Based on this representation, the system selects the next construction target, generates a symbolic sequence of skills for capable members of the robot team, and produces collision-free geometric motion plans for skill execution. The symbolic planning problem is dynamically regenerated as the construction state changes. An interactive digital twin presents the planned skill sequence and robot states to human co-workers for review and approval before execution. The method is evaluated through a construction assembly case study. By reducing the need to program robots separately for each task variation, the proposed approach supports more flexible deployment of collaborative robot teams in construction.

摘要（中文）：机器人具有显著潜力，能够实现施工过程的自动化。然而，其在行业中的应用仍然有限，部分原因在于将机器人适配至多样化任务所需的编程工作较为繁重。本文提出了一种技能序列规划方法，使得由多功能机器人组成的异构团队能够利用可复用的预编程技能（如抓取、钻孔和紧固）协作完成建筑装配工作。中央控制器将建筑物的数字表示转换为施工关系图，该图描述了施工实体、其状态及其父子关系。基于该表示，系统选择下一个施工目标，为机器人团队中具备相应能力的成员生成符号化的技能序列，并产出无碰撞的几何运动规划以执行技能。符号规划问题会随着施工状态的变化而动态重新生成。交互式数字孪生系统将规划好的技能序列和机器人状态呈现给人类协作者，供其在执行前进行审查和批准。该方法通过一个建筑装配案例研究进行了评估。通过减少针对每个任务变体单独编程机器人的需求，所提出的方法支持协作机器人团队在施工中更灵活的部署。

Authors: Xi Wang, Bo Fu, Carol C. Menassa, Vineet R. Kamat, Min Deng

DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation Manipulation

residual reinforcement learning dynamic manipulation demonstration generation planning-guided implicit curriculum

简要说明：DynaForge 是一个规划引导的残差学习框架，通过结合全局规划与强化学习训练的残差策略及隐式课程，生成高质量动态操作演示，在仿真和真实世界成功率上显著优于现有方法。

TLDR: DynaForge is a planning-guided residual learning framework that generates high-quality dynamic manipulation demonstrations by combining global planning with a residual policy trained via reinforcement learning and an implicit curriculum, achieving significant improvements in simulation and real-world success rates over prior methods.

Abstract: Dynamic object manipulation is essential for robots operating in real-world environments, yet methods for generating high-quality demonstrations remain limited. Methods designed for static tasks do not readily transfer to dynamic settings. Among dynamic demonstration generators, planning-based methods can fail near contact, while DOMINO-style replay simplifies dynamic interactions and may limit the experience available for policy learning. We present DynaForge, a planning-guided framework that learns residual corrections for dynamic manipulation demonstration generation. DynaForge combines low-frequency global planning with high-frequency object-centric inverse kinematics across task phases, and applies a residual policy to correct actions during dynamic interaction. An implicit curriculum groups rollouts under matched conditions and selects mixed-success groups, focusing residual reinforcement learning on the evolving competence frontier. On Can and Bottle, it uses 0.73x as many optimizer steps as vanilla GRPO at the same nominal environment-step budget, with higher observed final success rates. Across nine simulation tasks, DynaForge increases mean demonstration-generation success from 41.30% of the planning prior to 78.37%. With 800 demonstrations per task, DP3 policies trained on DynaForge data achieve 49.11% mean success, compared with 7.07% for DOMINO data. On three real-world dynamic tasks, DynaForge-trained policies achieve 30-60% success, compared with 0-10% for DOMINO-trained policies, showing the ability of DynaForge for sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：动态物体操作对于在真实世界环境中工作的机器人至关重要，然而生成高质量示范的方法仍然有限。为静态任务设计的方法难以直接迁移到动态场景中。在现有的动态示范生成方法中，基于规划的方法在接触附近可能失效，而DOMINO风格的回放方法简化了动态交互，可能限制策略学习可获得的经验。我们提出了DynaForge，一种规划引导的框架，用于学习动态操作示范生成的残差修正。DynaForge结合了低频全局规划与跨任务阶段的高频物体中心逆运动学，并应用残差策略在动态交互过程中修正动作。一种隐式课程在匹配条件下对回合进行分组，并选择混合成功组，将残差强化学习聚焦于不断演进的能力边界上。在Can和Bottle任务中，在相同的标称环境步数预算下，DynaForge使用的优化器步数仅为vanilla GRPO的0.73倍，同时取得了更高的最终成功率。在九个仿真任务中，DynaForge将示范生成的平均成功率从规划先验的41.30%提升至78.37%。每个任务使用800个示范时，基于DynaForge数据训练的DP3策略达到49.11%的平均成功率，而基于DOMINO数据的策略仅为7.07%。在三个真实世界动态任务中，DynaForge训练的策略达到30-60%的成功率，而DOMINO训练的策略仅为0-10%，展示了DynaForge在仿真到现实迁移中的能力。

Authors: Yiyang Jin, Yu Zheng, Xiao He, Hesheng Wang

Relative Contact Velocity-Controlled Hand-Object Mechanism for Dexterous Tool Manipulation Manipulation

relative contact velocity hand-object mechanism motion planning contact estimation dexterous manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种统一的手-物机制（HOM）框架，利用相对接触速度与接触力约束，使多种多指机械手能够完成灵巧的工具操作，并在仿真中通过遥操作验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) framework that uses relative contact velocities and contact force constraints to enable dexterous tool manipulation across multiple multifingered robotic hands, validated via teleoperation in simulation.

Abstract: This work investigates how to enable general multi-finger robotic hands to perform the complete tool manipulation process, which entails picking up a tool, loading it into a suitable pose, and then wielding it. Inspired by human tool manipulation and mechanical design principles, we model the hand and the tool as a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) composed of sub-assemblies. Specifically, we define a HOM as consisting of the hand, the object, and the generalized contact frames, allowing the HOM's motions to be expressed with the same set of Cartesian-space relative contact velocities, irrespective of the hand's kinematics and geometry. Then, we define a HOM's sub-assemblies as relative contact velocity and contact force constraints between fingers. Building on these definitions, we developed a lightweight and physically interpretable motion planning and contact estimation framework using least squares and a complementary filter. We evaluated our framework in simulation by teleoperating five different robotic hands. The results show that our framework enabled all five hands to execute the complete tool manipulation process, achieving dexterous behaviors even from identical, simple reference trajectories. Furthermore, the results showcase our framework's adaptability to different hands, tools, and tasks, enabled by its kinematic and geometric foundation.

摘要（中文）：本工作旨在研究如何使通用多指机器人手完成完整的工具操作过程，包括拾取工具、将其调整至合适的姿态，然后进行挥舞操作。受人类工具操作及机械设计原理的启发，我们将手与工具建模为一个由子装配体组成的统一手-物机构（HOM）。具体而言，我们将HOM定义为由手、物体及广义接触坐标系组成，从而使HOM的运动能够以同一组笛卡尔空间相对接触速度表达，不受手部运动学与几何结构的影响。在此基础上，我们将HOM的子装配体定义为手指之间的相对接触速度与接触力约束。基于上述定义，我们开发了一种轻量级且具有物理可解释性的运动规划与接触估计框架，采用最小二乘法与互补滤波器实现。我们在仿真环境中通过遥操作五种不同的机器人手对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，该框架使所有五种手均能完成完整的工具操作过程，即使在相同且简单的参考轨迹下也能实现灵巧的操作行为。此外，结果还展示了该框架在不同手型、工具及任务中的适应能力，这得益于其基于运动学与几何结构的基础设计。

Authors: Sunyu Wang, Jean Oh, Nancy S. Pollard

A Deployable Four-Finger Payload for Teleoperated Free-Flying Manipulation with Astrobee Manipulation

teleoperation free-flying manipulation zero-gravity simulation VR interface Astrobee

简要说明：本文介绍了用于Astrobee自由飞行器的双手机器人遥操作流程和可部署四指夹持器载荷，并在零重力MuJoCo国际空间站模拟器中演示了遥操作货物运输。该系统使用VR界面将人类手部动作映射到夹持器和Astrobee平移，并通过十次重复试验初步评估了任务成功率、接触保持、完成时间和货物运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and a deployable four-finger gripper payload for Astrobee free-flyers, demonstrating teleoperated cargo transport in a zero-gravity MuJoCo ISS simulator. The system uses a VR interface to map human hand motions to the gripper and Astrobee translation, with preliminary results from ten repeated trials measuring task success, contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.

Abstract: This article presents a bimanual teleoperation pipeline and conceptual design of a deployable four-finger payload for intra-vehicular free-flyers. Future habitats in low-Earth orbit (LEO) will require systems to perform mundane tasks like cargo handling and maintenance during crewed and uncrewed periods. The gripper payload provides 17 manipulation degrees-of-freedom (DoF) through four independently actuated fingers on a linear rail system. To control it, a virtual reality (VR) device interface maps the human ground operator's hand motions to the finger pairs, their separation to the rail, and common wrist motion to Astrobee translation. We present the preliminary results of teleoperating Astrobee in a custom zero-gravity MuJoCo-based International Space Station (ISS) simulator through ten repeated trials of transporting a rigid ISS Cargo Transfer Bag (CTB). We measure task success, continuous contact retention, completion time, and cargo motion.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了一种双臂遥操作流水线及一款可展开四指载荷的概念设计，该载荷适用于舱内自由飞行器。未来近地轨道（LEO）中的居住设施将需要系统在载人及无人期间执行货物搬运、维护等常规任务。该抓取器载荷通过线性滑轨系统上的四个独立驱动手指提供17个操作自由度（DoF）。为对其进行控制，虚拟现实（VR）设备接口将地面操作员的手部动作映射至手指对，手指间的间距映射至滑轨，而腕部的常见运动则映射至Astrobee的平移。我们展示了在基于MuJoCo的自定义零重力国际空间站（ISS）模拟器中，通过十次重复搬运刚性ISS货物转运袋（CTB）的任务，对Astrobee进行遥操作的初步结果。我们测量了任务成功率、连续接触保持能力、完成时间及货物运动情况。

Authors: William Su, Jordan Kam, Yunosuke Nakamura, Yixiao Wang, Jianshu Zhou, Masayoshi Tomizuka

Digital Twin-Driven VR Teleoperation with Multi-View Spatial Perception for Surgical Robots Manipulation

surgical robot digital twin VR teleoperation multi-view spatial perception da Vinci Research Kit

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于手术机器人的数字孪生驱动的VR遥操作平台，利用头戴式显示器的多视角渲染和手部姿态解耦控制，相比混合现实基线显著改善了深度感知和器械操控稳定性。

TLDR: This paper presents a digital twin-driven VR teleoperation platform for surgical robots, using HMD-based multi-view rendering and decoupled hand control to improve depth perception and instrument stability compared to mixed reality baselines.

Abstract: Current robot-assisted minimally-invasive surgery (RMIS) platforms provide a fixed console for the surgeon to view stereo endoscopic images and teleoperate instruments inside the patient. Several researchers have proposed the use of a head-mounted display (HMD) as a portable console, with video pass-through rendering of the endoscope images which, like the fixed console, restricts the operator to a single endoscopic viewpoint and limits depth perception. We present a digital twin-driven virtual reality (VR) teleoperation platform, where the digital twin is created from markerless perception of the surgical environment and streamed for display on the HMD. This overcomes the limitations of video pass-through by providing multi-view rendering and natural motion-parallax cues, enabling decoupling of the user's hand posture from strict instrument alignment. The system utilizes VR hand controllers to increase the teleoperation workspace and to improve the robustness and stability of instrument control compared to the hand tracking approach adopted by most prior systems. A 15-participant user study on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) shows that our VR platform significantly outperforms a state-of-the-art HoloLens 2 mixed reality baseline, reducing path length by 86% and jerk by 95%, while achieving depth perception confidence comparable to or exceeding the traditional console across all conditions.

摘要（中文）：当前的手术机器人辅助微创手术（RMIS）平台为外科医生提供了固定控制台，用于观看立体内窥镜图像并操控患者体内的器械。部分研究者提出将头戴式显示器（HMD）作为便携式控制台，通过视频透视技术渲染内窥镜图像，但与传统固定控制台类似，这种方案仍将操作者限制于单一内窥镜视角，并影响深度感知。我们提出了一种由数字孪生驱动的虚拟现实（VR）遥操作平台，其中数字孪生基于对手术环境的无标记感知构建，并流式传输至HMD进行显示。该平台通过提供多视角渲染和自然的运动视差线索，突破了视频透视技术的局限，实现用户手部姿态与器械严格对齐的解耦。系统采用VR手部控制器，相比现有大多数系统所采用的手部追踪方法，扩大了遥操作工作空间，并提升了器械控制的稳健性和稳定性。在达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上进行的15名参与者用户研究表明，我们的VR平台显著优于先进的HoloLens 2混合现实基线系统，路径长度减少了86%，加速度变化率（jerk）降低了95%，同时在各条件下，其深度感知置信度达到甚至超过传统控制台的水平。

Authors: Chang Liu, Chenhao Yu, Honghao Zhao, Hao Ding, Haochen Wei, Adnan Munawar, Mathias Unberath, Peter Kazanzides

RoboMP-DINOv2: Prompts, Not Filters for Robust Robot Manipulation Manipulation

vision-language-action robot manipulation DINOv2 mask-prompting diffusion policy

简要说明：RoboMP-DINOv2将分割掩码视为空间提示而非过滤器，将区域特定嵌入注入密集DINOv2特征中，用于全场景机器人操作策略。 它引入了掩码区域颜色随机化(MCR)以增强外观鲁棒性，在空间位移、杂乱场景和未见物体颜色下相比基于DINOv2的扩散策略基线取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: RoboMP-DINOv2 treats segmentation masks as spatial prompts rather than filters, injecting region-specific embeddings into dense DINOv2 features for full-scene robot manipulation policies. It introduces masked-region color randomization (MCR) to improve appearance robustness, achieving higher success rates under spatial shifts, clutter, and unseen object colors compared to DINOv2-based Diffusion Policy baselines.

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies must generalize across visual shifts while preserving scene context relevant to action. General-purpose vision encoders are not tailored to visuomotor control, while object-centric approaches often use segmentation masks as hard filters that discard potentially useful context. We propose RoboMP-DINOv2 (Robotics Mask-Prompted DINOv2), a full-scene vision encoder that treats masks as spatial prompts rather than visibility filters. It extracts dense DINOv2 features from the full observation, injects learned region-specific embeddings at masked locations, and jointly contextualizes prompted and unprompted tokens for action prediction. We further introduce masked-region color randomization (MCR) to improve appearance robustness, yielding RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR. Across seven simulated manipulation settings, RoboMP-DINOv2 achieves 60.7% success under spatial shifts and 59.7% under scene clutter, compared with 50.7% and 41.0% for a DINOv2-based Diffusion Policy. Under unseen object colors, RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR achieves 72.5% success versus 35.1% for the strongest color-randomized baseline. Additional experiments and representation analyses show improved robustness while preserving behaviorally relevant scene information. Code is available at https://github.com/han20192019/RoboMP_DINOv2.

摘要（中文）：机器人操控策略必须在应对视觉变化的同时，保留与动作相关的场景上下文信息。通用视觉编码器并非针对视觉运动控制而设计，而基于物体的方法通常将分割掩码用作硬性过滤器，从而丢弃了可能有用的上下文信息。我们提出RoboMP-DINOv2（机器人掩码提示DINOv2），一种将掩码视为空间提示而非可见性过滤器的全场景视觉编码器。它从完整观测中提取稠密的DINOv2特征，在掩码位置注入学习得到的区域特定嵌入，并对带提示与不带提示的令牌进行联合上下文化处理以预测动作。我们进一步引入掩码区域颜色随机化（MCR）以提升外观鲁棒性，从而得到RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR。在七个仿真操控场景中，RoboMP-DINOv2在空间偏移下成功率达到60.7%，在场景杂乱下达到59.7%，而基于DINOv2的扩散策略分别仅为50.7%和41.0%。在未见物体颜色条件下，RoboMP-DINOv2-MCR成功率达到72.5%，而最强的颜色随机化基线仅为35.1%。额外的实验和表征分析表明，该方法在提升鲁棒性的同时保留了与行为相关的场景信息。代码已公开于https://github.com/han20192019/RoboMP_DINOv2。

Authors: Han Qi, Heng Yang

Learning to Plan in Human-Robot Collaboration: Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Interaction RLRobot

reinforcement learning human-robot collaboration multimodal interaction interaction manager

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于强化学习的交互管理器，用于在家庭环境中辅助用户的机器人，从模拟人类数据中学习多模态策略，并通过真实世界的人类研究验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based interaction manager for a robot assisting users in a home environment, which learns multimodal policies from simulated human data and is validated in a real-world human study.

Abstract: Robot assistants for older adults and people with disabilities need to perform collaborative tasks with users effectively. The core component of these systems is an interaction manager whose job is to observe and assess the task and infer the state of the human and their intent for the robot to choose the best course of action. Due to the sparseness of the data in this domain, the policy for such multimodal systems is often crafted by hand; as the complexity of interactions grows, this process is not scalable. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to automatically generate the multimodal policy of the robot. Our system focuses on a realistic scenario where a robot assists a user in locating objects within a home environment, managing multimodal signals, including language and physical actions, to select the best action. In contrast to traditional dialog systems, our agent is trained with a simulator that uses human data and can deal with multiple modalities. We use a simple high-level reward function that needs no fine-tuning and enforce some preconditions to speed up the training process. A human study evaluating the system in a real-world setting demonstrates promising results, indicating high usability and effective task completion. This RL-based approach offers a scalable and interpretable alternative for designing interaction managers in multimodal human-robot collaborations.

摘要（中文）：为老年人和残障人士设计的机器人助手需要与用户有效执行协作任务。这些系统的核心组件是交互管理器，其职责在于观察与评估任务进展，推断人类状态及其意图，以便机器人选择最佳行动方案。由于该领域数据较为稀疏，此类多模态系统的策略往往依赖人工设计；然而，随着交互复杂性的增加，这一过程难以扩展。本文提出了一种强化学习（RL）方法，用于自动生成机器人的多模态策略。我们的系统聚焦于一个现实场景：机器人辅助用户在家居环境中定位物品，通过处理包括语言和物理动作在内的多模态信号来选择最优行动。与传统对话系统不同，我们的智能体使用基于人类数据的模拟器进行训练，并能够处理多种模态。我们采用一个简单且无需精细调整的高层奖励函数，并设置若干前置条件以加速训练进程。一项在真实环境中评估该系统的人机交互研究展现了颇具前景的结果，表明该系统具有较高的可用性并能有效完成任务。这种基于强化学习的方法为多模态人机协作中交互管理器的设计提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

Authors: Afagh Mehri Shervedani, Siyu Li, Natawut Monaikul, Bahareh Abbasi, Barbara Di Eugenio, Miloš Žefran

QuantWM: Temporally Consistent 2-Bit KV Cache Quantization for World Models and Video Generation WorldModel

KV cache quantization temporal consistency world models video generation attention preservation

简要说明：QuantWM 是一种免训练的 2 位 KV 缓存量化框架，通过保持注意力 logits 和时空 token 选择，利用量化敏感度感知聚类和主子空间注意力补偿，提升了视频生成和世界模型的时间一致性和视觉质量。

TLDR: QuantWM is a training-free 2-bit KV cache quantization framework that improves temporal consistency and visual quality in video generation and world models by preserving attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection through quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering and principal-subspace attention compensation.

Abstract: KV cache memory has become a major deployment bottleneck for video generation and world models, which motivates low-bit quantization study for efficiency. Existing 2-bit KV cache quantization methods can achieve nearly lossless performance on video benchmarks such as VBench, however, we find that they still cause severe temporal flickering and visual degradation. Meanwhile, deeper investigates show that Key quantization produces smaller reconstruction errors than Value, but surprisingly leads to much larger output degradation. We trace this discrepancy to attention: small Key perturbations can change the attention logits, i.e., QK^\top, and shift the temporal-spatial tokens selected by Queries. These observations motivate us to explicitly preserve attention logits and temporal-spatial token selection during KV cache quantization to alleviate the visual degradation problem. To address this issue, we present QuantWM, a training-free and strictly causal 2-bit KV cache quantization framework. QuantWM introduces two complementary techniques to mitigate the attention shifts. Firstly, quantization-sensitivity-aware clustering (QSAC) jointly considers historical Query sensitivity and residual ranges to select INT2-friendly Key centroids, which reduces quantization errors in channels that are more critical to attention. In addition, principal-subspace attention compensation (PSAC) restores the remaining Key errors along the dominant Query subspace using low-rank projections, which provides a direct and efficient correction to stabilize attention logits. Extensive experiments on Causal-Forcing, LingBot-World-v2, HY-World 1.5, Matrix-Game-2 and Longcat-Video demonstrate that QuantWM significantly improves visual quality and temporal consistency, while outperforming existing methods across image and video quality metrics with up to 6.20x KV cache memory compression and limited additional overhead.

摘要（中文）：KV缓存内存已成为视频生成和世界模型的主要部署瓶颈，这促使研究者探索低比特量化以提高效率。现有的2比特KV缓存量化方法在VBench等视频基准上几乎可以实现无损性能，然而我们发现这些方法仍会导致严重的时间闪烁和视觉退化。此外，更深入的研究表明，Key量化产生的重建误差小于Value，但令人惊讶的是，它导致的输出退化却远大于Value。我们将这一差异追溯到注意力机制：微小的Key扰动会改变注意力logits（即QK^\top），并改变Query选择的时间-空间令牌。这些观察促使我们在KV缓存量化过程中显式保留注意力logits和时间-空间令牌选择，以缓解视觉退化问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了QuantWM，一种无需训练且严格因果的2比特KV缓存量化框架。QuantWM引入了两种互补技术来缓解注意力偏移。首先，量化敏感度感知聚类（QSAC）联合考虑历史Query敏感度和残差范围，选择对INT2友好的Key质心，从而减少对注意力更关键的通道中的量化误差。此外，主子空间注意力补偿（PSAC）利用低秩投影沿着主Query子空间恢复剩余的Key误差，为稳定注意力logits提供了直接而高效的修正。在Causal-Forcing、LingBot-World-v2、HY-World 1.5、Matrix-Game-2和Longcat-Video上的大量实验表明，QuantWM显著改善了视觉质量和时间一致性，在图像和视频质量指标上均优于现有方法，实现了高达6.20倍的KV缓存内存压缩，且额外开销有限。

Authors: Jiaqi Zhao, Xiaobin Hu, Bo Yin, Junpeng Jiang, Miao Zhang, Shuicheng Yan

Dual-Frontier: When Can an Agent Trust Its World Model? WorldModel

failure attribution world-model verification certified advantage bounds counterfactual decomposition verify-then-promote

简要说明：本文形式化了世界模型引导决策中的失败归因问题，证明了被动交互下的不可辨识性，并提出了Dual-Frontier学习原则，通过认证界限决定何时信任世界模型预测，并在受控和现实智能体流程中验证。

TLDR: This paper formalizes the failure-attribution problem in world-model-guided decision-making, proving non-identifiability from passive interaction, and introduces Dual-Frontier, a learning principle with certified bounds for when to trust world-model predictions, validated in controlled and realistic agent pipelines.

Abstract: Learned world models are becoming essential to general-purpose agents: by predicting action consequences, they support planning and decision-making while reducing reliance on costly trial and error. This reliance creates a fundamental ambiguity: when a world-model-guided decision fails, the trajectory alone may not reveal whether the agent's decision rule or the world model caused the loss. We formalize this failure-attribution problem as a counterfactual decomposition of return loss and prove that its components are not identifiable from passive interaction, even for finite-horizon planners. This obstruction motivates Dual-Frontier, a learning principle that admits a world-model-guided decision only when its predicted advantage exceeds a certified bound on decision-relevant world-model error; otherwise, evidence is allocated to world-model verification. Action-conditioned value bounds and a closed-loop extension guarantee non-decreasing return for admitted decisions. Calibrated gates and simultaneous confidence sequences support adaptive evidence reuse, with sufficient and necessary verification bounds. Controlled learned-model experiments validate the predicted failure modes and certification behavior, while cross-backbone tool-use benchmarks instantiate the same verify-then-promote rule in realistic agent world-model pipelines, consistently improving decision quality and reliability.

摘要（中文）：学习型世界模型正逐渐成为通用智能体的核心组成部分：通过预测行动后果，它们能够支持规划与决策，同时减少对高代价试错过程的依赖。然而，这种依赖也引入了一种根本性的模糊性：当基于世界模型的决策失败时，仅凭轨迹数据往往无法判断损失究竟源于智能体的决策规则，还是源于世界模型本身。我们将这一失败归因问题形式化为回报损失的反事实分解，并证明即使对于有限时域规划器，其各组成部分也无法仅通过被动交互加以识别。这一障碍促使我们提出双前沿（Dual-Frontier）学习原则，该原则仅在预测优势超过决策相关世界模型误差的认证界限时，才允许采用由世界模型引导的决策；否则，相关证据将被用于世界模型的验证。行动条件价值界限与闭环扩展共同保证了被采纳决策的回报非递减。校准门控与同步置信序列支持自适应的证据复用，并提供了充分且必要的验证界限。受控学习模型实验验证了所预测的失败模式与认证行为，而跨骨干网络工具使用基准测试则将同一“先验证后提升”规则应用于现实智能体世界模型流程中，持续提升了决策质量与可靠性。

Authors: Huatai Zhu, Qiang Chen, Ziqian Kou, Wenhao Li, Fei Wang, Yichao Cao, Xiu Su, Yi Chen

Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling WorldModel

world modeling code generation video generation multi-agent open-ended interaction

简要说明：CoDeR 提出了一种新的世界建模范式，将可执行代码用于世界结构和动态，并结合视频生成进行视觉呈现，实现了长期记忆、开放式交互和多智能体持续性。

TLDR: CoDeR introduces a new paradigm for world modeling that combines executable code for world structure/dynamics with video generation for visual rendering, enabling long-term memory, open-ended interactions, and multi-agent persistence.

Abstract: We introduce \textbf{CoDeR}, a new paradigm for world modeling. Unlike existing video world models that implicitly represent world dynamics through visual observations, our system explicitly constructs an executable world with code and employs video generation models for visual realization. Specifically, we coordinate five complementary roles to translate high-level concepts into structured world rules, executable dynamics, and perceptual observations. This design enables \textit{long-term memory}, \textit{open-ended interactions}, \textit{autonomous world evolution}, and \textit{multi-agent scenarios}, where multiple entities can act, interact, and evolve persistently beyond the current observation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially extends the capabilities of existing world models, enabling long-term memory, open-ended interactions, autonomous evolution, and persistent multi-agent dynamics, while achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple evaluation settings. Code and model weights will be made publicly available. Project Page: \href{https://becauseimbatman0.github.io/CoDeR}{CoDeR}.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种世界建模的新范式\textbf{CoDeR}。与现有通过视觉观察隐式表示世界动态的视频世界模型不同，我们的系统显式地以代码构建可执行世界，并借助视频生成模型实现视觉呈现。具体而言，我们协调五个互补角色，将高层概念转化为结构化的世界规则、可执行的动态以及感知观察。该设计实现了\textit{长期记忆}、\textit{开放式交互}、\textit{自主世界演化}以及\textit{多智能体场景}，其中多个实体能够在当前观察之外持续行动、交互和演化。大量实验表明，我们的框架显著扩展了现有世界模型的能力，支持长期记忆、开放式交互、自主演化以及持久的多智能体动态，同时在多个评估设置中达到最先进的性能。代码和模型权重将公开提供。项目页面：\href{https://becauseimbatman0.github.io/CoDeR}{CoDeR}。

Authors: Zixun Fang, Yawen Shao, Kai Zhu, Jie Xiao, Shihan Chen, Yu Liu, Xueyang Fu, Yang Cao, Wei Zhai, Zheng-Jun Zha

Metric-Bench: Exploring In-context Spatial Metric Reasoning in VLMs for Indoor Scenes Other

spatial metric reasoning in-context learning reinforcement fine-tuning embodied AI VLM benchmark

简要说明：Metric-Bench 是一个利用图像内参考对象评估 VLM 空间度量推理的基准，MetricReasoner 是一种强化微调方法，在提升度量推理和下游具身任务性能的同时保持通用能力。

TLDR: Metric-Bench is a benchmark for spatial metric reasoning in VLMs using in-image reference objects, and MetricReasoner is a reinforcement fine-tuning recipe that improves metric reasoning and downstream embodied performance without sacrificing general capabilities.

Abstract: Metric reasoning is a critical and challenging task for Vision Language Models (VLMs), playing a pivotal role in embodied AI tasks such as robotic manipulation and autonomous navigation. However, current spatial reasoning remains bottlenecked by rigid pixel-level supervision; such localized optimization often compromises general multimodal intelligence, triggering performance degradation or catastrophic forgetting of broad reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce Metric-Bench, a focused benchmark designed to guide metric-spatial reasoning using contextual information. By incorporating in-image reference objects with known physical dimensions, Metric-Bench guides models to implicitly learn the 2D-to-3D mapping without camera intrinsics. We further present MetricReasoner, a task-adapted reinforcement fine-tuning recipe for reference-grounded metric reasoning, using structured prompts and verifiable numerical rewards. Extensive experiments on Metric-Bench demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances spatial metric understanding, outperforming existing and even larger proprietary models by 43.1\%, while improving downstream embodied performance over a spatial-specialized counterpart by 30.4\% on RoboSpatial overall accuracy and 9.3\% on ERQA, and additionally delivering consistent gains on general benchmarks (15.9\% on V$\star$Bench, 88.9\% on BLINK), indicating that the proposed adaptation does not necessarily compromise general VLM capabilities.

摘要（中文）：度量推理是视觉语言模型（VLMs）中一项关键且具有挑战性的任务，在具身智能任务（如机器人操作和自主导航）中发挥着核心作用。然而，当前的空间推理仍受制于僵化的像素级监督；这种局部优化往往损害多模态通用智能，导致广泛推理能力的性能下降或灾难性遗忘。为克服这些局限，我们提出了Metric-Bench，一个专注于利用上下文信息引导度量空间推理的基准数据集。通过引入图像内具有已知物理尺寸的参考物体，Metric-Bench引导模型隐式学习二维到三维映射，而无需相机内参。我们进一步提出MetricReasoner，一种针对参考锚定度量推理的任务自适应强化微调方法，采用结构化提示和可验证的数值奖励。在Metric-Bench上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了空间度量理解能力，超越现有甚至更大规模的专有模型达43.1%；在下游具身任务中，相较于空间专用模型，在RoboSpatial总体准确率上提升30.4%，在ERQA上提升9.3%；同时，在通用基准上持续取得提升（V$\star$Bench上提升15.9%，BLINK上提升88.9%），表明所提出的自适应方法并不必然损害VLM的通用能力。

Authors: Yuling Xi, Haokai Zhang, Muzhi Zhu, Hao Zhong, Zongze Du, Hengyu Zhao, Chenchen Jing, Yufei Yin, Bin Qin, Yongjie Yang, Zhenbo Luo, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen

Real-World Perception for Autonomous Driving in Adverse Weather: Enhancing Standard Detectors via Foundation-Guided Auto-Annotation AutonomousDriving

auto-annotation adverse weather object detection SAM3 fine-tuning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于基础模型引导的自动标注流程，利用SAM3生成伪标签来微调标准目标检测器（如YOLOv8），在不改变架构的情况下，显著提升了自动驾驶在恶劣天气和光照条件下的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a foundation-guided auto-annotation pipeline that uses SAM3 to generate pseudo-labels for fine-tuning standard object detectors like YOLOv8, significantly improving their performance in adverse weather and lighting conditions for autonomous driving without architectural changes.

Abstract: Standard deployment-ready object detectors for autonomous vehicles degrade in adverse weather and lighting conditions without being trained on extensive domain-specific data. While large-scale vision foundation models offer robust zero-shot generalization, their high computational cost makes them impractical for real-time deployment. To bridge this gap, we propose a foundation-guided auto-annotation pipeline that enhances standard detectors without architectural changes. We first benchmark three distinct models, YOLOv8, Co-DETR, and SAM3, on our custom real-world driving dataset spanning 25 unique operational scenarios across various route, weather, and lighting conditions. Based on our analysis, SAM3 demonstrates superior accuracy and resilience across all scenarios. Thus, we deploy it as an offline auto-annotator to generate pseudo-labels on the unannotated subset of our dataset. Fine-tuning the baseline YOLOv8 on these annotations yields a 16.04% higher overall mean Average Precision (mAP) and improves cross-environmental stability compared to the baseline model, highlighted by a 32.73% and 28.65% mAP increase in Residential Direct Sunlight and Highway Fog, respectively. These results demonstrate that standard detectors can achieve environmental resilience without the need for extensive manual annotation or architectural modifications.

摘要（中文）：标准部署就绪的自动驾驶目标检测器在恶劣天气和光照条件下，若未经过大量特定领域数据的训练，其性能会显著下降。尽管大规模视觉基础模型具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但其高昂的计算成本使其难以实现实时部署。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种基于基础模型引导的自动标注流水线，在不改变模型架构的前提下提升标准检测器的性能。我们首先在我们自建的真实驾驶数据集上对三种不同模型——YOLOv8、Co-DETR和SAM3——进行了基准测试，该数据集涵盖25种不同的运营场景，涉及多种路线、天气和光照条件。基于分析结果，SAM3在所有场景中表现出卓越的准确性和鲁棒性。因此，我们将其部署为离线自动标注器，为数据集中未标注的子集生成伪标签。基于这些标注对基线YOLOv8进行微调后，其整体平均精度（mAP）相较于基线模型提升了16.04%，并增强了跨环境稳定性，其中在住宅区直射阳光和高速公路雾天场景下的mAP分别提升了32.73%和28.65%。这些结果表明，标准检测器无需大量人工标注或架构修改即可实现环境鲁棒性。

Authors: Sepideh Gohari, Goodarz Mehr, Azim Eskandarian

TM-APR: Thermal Temporal-Memory Localization via Analytic Online Adaptation Other

Thermal Visual Place Recognition Analytic Class-Incremental Learning Autonomous Navigation Online Adaptation SLAM

简要说明：本文提出TM-APR，将分析类增量学习与控制理论适配（无迹传播、高斯混合划分、极小极大H∞优化）相结合，实现鲁棒的域不变热视觉地点识别，以闭式O(1)更新满足实时SLAM延迟约束。

TLDR: The paper proposes TM-APR, a framework that integrates Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with control-theoretic adaptations (Unscented propagation, Gaussian Mixture partitioning, and minimax H-infinity optimization) to achieve robust, domain-invariant thermal visual place recognition for autonomous navigation, with closed-form O(1) updates that meet real-time SLAM latency constraints.

Abstract: Thermal Visual Place Recognition (Thermal VPR) maps camera observations to metric poses within a mapped environment, serving as a prerequisite for autonomous navigation. However, thermal VPR suffers from severe environmental dependence, heavy online retraining overheads, and an inability to model dynamic non-linear shifts, causing existing frameworks to fail during online deployment. To achieve robust domain-invariant place recognition, we bridge Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (ACIL) with domain-invariant VPR for the first time, revealing that its gradient-free matrix updates construct a surprisingly strong baseline that outperforms conventional fine-tuning. Nevertheless, standard ACIL exhibits a critical vulnerability to extreme non-linear thermal fluctuations due to its structural linear assumptions. To overcome this limitation, we exploit a novel algebraic equivalence between ACIL and modern control theory, proposing a framework which embeds Unscented propagation (U-ACIL), Gaussian Mixture partitioning (GMM-ACIL), and minimax $H_\infty$ optimization ($H_\infty$-ACIL) directly into the update loop. Our formulation guarantees exact closed-form matrix updates within $\mathcal{O}(1)$ computational complexity, bypassing backpropagation to ensure that the online update latency ($Δt_{\mathrm{learn}}$) remains strictly bounded below the sensor acquisition interval ($Δt_{\mathrm{acquire}}$), thereby eliminating trajectory jumps in real-time SLAM pipelines.

摘要（中文）：热视觉地点识别（Thermal VPR）将相机观测映射到已建图环境中的度量位姿，是自主导航的前提条件。然而，热视觉地点识别存在严重的环境依赖性、高昂的在线重训练开销，以及无法建模动态非线性偏移等问题，导致现有框架在在线部署时失效。为实现鲁棒的域不变地点识别，我们首次将解析类增量学习（ACIL）与域不变视觉地点识别相结合，揭示其无梯度矩阵更新构建了一个令人惊讶的强基线，性能优于传统微调方法。然而，标准ACIL因其结构性的线性假设，对极端非线性热波动表现出关键脆弱性。为克服该局限，我们利用ACIL与现代控制理论之间的一种新颖代数等价性，提出一个将无迹传播（U-ACIL）、高斯混合划分（GMM-ACIL）和极小极大$H_\infty$优化（$H_\infty$-ACIL）直接嵌入更新循环的框架。我们的公式在$\mathcal{O}(1)$计算复杂度内保证精确的闭式矩阵更新，绕开反向传播，从而确保在线更新延迟（$\Delta t_{\mathrm{learn}}$）严格限制在传感器采集间隔（$\Delta t_{\mathrm{acquire}}$）以内，进而消除实时SLAM流水线中的轨迹跳变。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical framework combining long-horizon geometric planning with deep Koopman model predictive control for autonomous wheel-loader V-cycle maneuvers, validated in high-fidelity simulations.

Abstract: The repeated forward-reverse maneuvers performed by wheel loaders during earthmoving operations make them well suited for automation. However, the nonlinear dynamics of articulated vehicles and complex vehicle-terrain interactions limit the effectiveness of conventional model-based approaches. This paper presents a hierarchical framework that combines long-horizon geometric planning with data-driven predictive control for autonomous wheel-loader operation. A reduced-order articulated kinematic model is used to generate the maneuver geometry, where the forward and reverse trajectories are jointly optimized through a shared intermediate state. To capture the vehicle dynamics, two data-driven deep bilinear Koopman models are learned for the forward and reverse motions using data generated from high-fidelity simulations in Algoryx Dynamics. The learned Koopman representations are subsequently incorporated into a computationally efficient model predictive control (MPC) formulation for trajectory tracking. The resulting controller operates in real time within a 50-ms execution loop. High-fidelity simulation results demonstrate that the proposed end-to-end framework enables accurate and computationally efficient execution of wheel-loader V-cycle maneuvers, providing a promising approach toward autonomous operation of articulated heavy-duty machinery.

摘要（中文）：轮式装载机在土方作业中执行的反复前进-后退操作使其非常适合自动化。然而，铰接式车辆的非线性动力学特性以及复杂的车辆-地形相互作用限制了传统基于模型方法的有效性。本文提出了一种分层框架，将长时域几何规划与数据驱动的预测控制相结合，用于轮式装载机的自主操作。利用降阶铰接运动学模型生成操纵几何路径，其中前进和后退轨迹通过共享的中间状态进行联合优化。为捕捉车辆动力学特性，使用Algoryx Dynamics中高保真仿真生成的数据，分别学习了前进和后退运动的两个数据驱动深度双线性Koopman模型。随后，将学习到的Koopman表示纳入计算高效的模型预测控制（MPC）公式中，用于轨迹跟踪。所得到的控制器在50毫秒执行周期内实现实时运行。高保真仿真结果表明，所提出的端到端框架能够实现轮式装载机V形循环操作的精确且计算高效的执行，为铰接式重型机械的自主操作提供了一种有前景的方法。

Authors: Armin Abdolmohammadi, Navid Mojahed, Dinesh Kumar, Bahram Ravani, Shima Nazari

Benchmarking Robots for Everyday Environments: From Lab Experiments to Real-World Operations Other

benchmarking real-world deployment public environments robotic evaluation field testing

简要说明：本文介绍了一个跨学科基准框架，用于在三年内评估机器人在真实公共环境中的表现，涵盖任务完成度、交互、安全性和经济性。

TLDR: This paper introduces an interdisciplinary benchmarking framework for evaluating robots in real-world public environments over three years, assessing task fulfillment, interaction, safety, and economics across three use cases.

Abstract: This study introduces an interdisciplinary framework for benchmarking robots deployed in public environments, addressing the gap between traditional laboratory metrics and real-world benchmarking requirements. We evaluate three distinct robots across diverse use cases - outdoor park cleaning, pedestrian underpass cleaning, and interactive library assistance - each representing unique challenges in public daily life. Over a three-year benchmarking process (2023-2025) comprising seven benchmarking events, a consensus workshop and six on-site evaluations (two per use case), we utilized realistic indoor and outdoor test environments to assess not only technical performance but also the broader implications of deploying robots in unstructured, human-centric settings. An expert panel, spanning robotics, human-robot interaction, safety, and economics, systematically developed and refined an evaluation concept to analyze the transition from laboratory prototypes to operational systems. Our findings highlight critical factors for successful deployment, including task fulfillment, interaction quality, safety, and economic feasibility. This work provides actionable insights for researchers and practitioners aiming to bridge the gap between robotic innovation and real-world applicability.

摘要（中文）：本研究提出了一种跨学科框架，用于对在公共环境中部署的机器人进行基准测试，以弥补传统实验室指标与实际基准测试需求之间的差距。我们评估了三种不同机器人在多个应用场景中的表现——包括户外公园清洁、行人地下通道清洁以及交互式图书馆辅助——每一种场景都代表了公共日常生活中的独特挑战。在为期三年的基准测试过程中（2023—2025年），我们组织了七次基准测试活动、一次共识研讨会以及六次现场评估（每个应用场景两次），利用贴近现实的室内与室外测试环境，不仅评估了技术性能，还探讨了在非结构化、以人为本的环境中部署机器人的更广泛影响。由机器人学、人机交互、安全性和经济学领域的专家组成的小组，系统性地制定并完善了一套评估理念，以分析从实验室原型到实际运行系统的转化过程。我们的研究结果突显了成功部署的关键因素，包括任务完成度、交互质量、安全性和经济可行性。本研究为致力于弥合机器人创新与实际应用之间鸿沟的研究人员和实践者提供了具有操作性的见解。

ArborSplat: Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Orchards Other

semantic SLAM 3D Gaussian Splatting orchard robotics LiDAR odometry height-band constraints

简要说明：ArborSplat是一个面向果园机器人的在线语义3D高斯泼溅SLAM系统，结合LiDAR里程计和类别约束的语义优化及高度带约束，精确映射树干和果实等细薄结构，在准确性和速度上优于现有方法。

TLDR: ArborSplat is an online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system for orchard robots, integrating LiDAR odometry with class-constrained semantic optimization and height-band constraints to accurately map thin structures like trunks and fruit, outperforming existing methods in accuracy and speed.

Abstract: Orchard robots need maps that preserve small but semantically important structures such as trunks, trellises, and fruit. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM achieves high photometric fidelity. However, its optimization remains appearance-driven, and transferring image semantics to 3D points is unreliable for thin structures, whose pixels may receive depth from background surfaces. We present ArborSplat, an online semantic 3DGS SLAM system that tracks with LiDAR odometry and optimizes semantics directly on the Gaussian map, constrained by class-specific height bands above a ground plane fitted to each keyframe's stereo point cloud, and fuses multi-view evidence into a semantic point cloud online while rejecting labels inconsistent with the local ground surface or with monocular depth. Class-constrained refinement reserves Gaussian capacity for underrepresented structures and, under reduced budgets, increases training-view accuracy on tree classes. We evaluate the approach on apple and pear orchards during dormancy, flowering, and harvesting. On full routes, it keeps ATE below 0.5 m on all 12 traversals. On shared 301-frame segments, it exceeds SGS-SLAM and GS3LAM by 0.23 to 0.50 training-view and 0.15 to 0.36 held-out mIoU while running 1.7 to 7.5 times faster, whereas SemGauss-SLAM runs out of GPU memory on all six.

摘要（中文）：果园机器人需要能够保留细小但语义上重要的结构（如树干、棚架和果实）的地图。3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）SLAM实现了较高的光度保真度。然而，其优化仍以外观驱动为主，将图像语义转移到3D点上对于细薄结构而言并不可靠，因为这些结构对应的像素可能从背景表面获取深度。我们提出了ArborSplat，一种在线语义3DGS SLAM系统，该系统使用LiDAR里程计进行跟踪，并直接在高斯地图上优化语义，约束条件为基于每个关键帧立体点云拟合的地平面以上的类别特定高度带，同时在线将多视角证据融合为语义点云，并拒绝与局部地面或单目深度不一致的标签。类别约束的细化保留了高斯容量给代表性不足的结构，并在预算减少的情况下提高了树类别的训练视角精度。我们在苹果园和梨园的休眠期、开花期和收获期对该方法进行了评估。在完整路径上，所有12次遍历的ATE均保持在0.5米以下。在共享的301帧片段上，该方法在训练视角mIoU上超过SGS-SLAM和GS3LAM 0.23至0.50，在保留视角mIoU上超过0.15至0.36，同时运行速度快1.7至7.5倍，而SemGauss-SLAM在全部六个片段上均出现GPU内存不足的情况。

Authors: Alessandro Masini, Matteo Frosi, Mirko Usuelli, Matteo Matteucci

MATES: Learning Multi-Agent Interactions by Transforming Observations for Frozen Single-Agent Policies RLRobot

multi-agent reinforcement learning observation transformation frozen policies input-side adaptation coordination

简要说明：MATES 提出了一种输入侧适配器，将多智能体观测转换为冻结的单智能体策略所需的格式，从而在不修改预训练策略的情况下实现高效的多智能体协调。在路径规划、导航和合作发现等任务中，它仅训练少量参数即超越了从头训练的 MARL 方法。

TLDR: MATES introduces an input-side adapter that transforms multi-agent observations to fit a frozen single-agent policy, enabling efficient multi-agent coordination without modifying the pretrained policy. It outperforms MARL from scratch on pathfinding, navigation, and cooperative discovery while training only a small fraction of parameters.

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) commonly trains decentralized policies from scratch, requiring agents to acquire individual task competence and coordination simultaneously. Yet many multi-agent problems admit a compatible single-agent counterpart in which the underlying task can be learned in isolation. We introduce Multi-Agent Observation Transformation for Existing Single-Agent Policies (MATES), an input-side adaptation framework for tasks whose multi-agent observations preserve the solo-task information while exposing separately identifiable neighbor information. From multi-agent experience, MATES learns a small adapter that maps this observation into the format expected by a frozen single-agent policy, inducing actions suited to the shared environment without updating the single-agent policy itself. MATES leaves the pretrained policy's internal architecture unchanged and retains the objectives and update procedures of the underlying MARL algorithm. We evaluate MATES using both on- and off-policy algorithms on lifelong pathfinding, navigation, and cooperative discovery, spanning discrete and continuous observation and action spaces. Across all evaluated settings, MATES optimizes only 3.5-7.3% as many parameters as full-policy training while consistently outperforming MARL training from scratch. It approaches the performance of full fine-tuning, remains competitive overall with demonstration-based baselines, and retains strong task performance at team sizes not encountered during training. These results provide evidence that, under this observation structure, effective multi-agent behavior can be learned without modifying the policy that encodes individual competence.

摘要（中文）：多智能体强化学习（MARL）通常从零开始训练分散式策略，要求智能体同时获得个体任务能力和协调能力。然而，许多多智能体问题存在兼容的单智能体对应形式，其中底层任务可以独立学习。我们提出了面向现有单智能体策略的多智能体观测变换方法（MATES），这是一种输入端适配框架，适用于多智能体观测在保留单独任务信息的同时暴露可单独识别的邻居信息的任务。基于多智能体经验，MATES学习一个小型适配器，将该观测映射为冻结的单智能体策略所期望的格式，从而在不更新单智能体策略本身的情况下，诱导出适应共享环境的动作。MATES保持预训练策略的内部架构不变，并保留底层MARL算法的目标和更新流程。我们使用在策略和离策略算法，在终身路径规划、导航和协作发现任务上评估MATES，涵盖离散和连续的观测空间与动作空间。在所有评估设置中，MATES仅优化全策略训练参数量的3.5%-7.3%，同时 consistently 优于从零开始的MARL训练。它接近完全微调的性能，在与基于演示的基线方法相比时整体保持竞争力，并在训练中未遇到过的团队规模下保持较强的任务性能。这些结果表明，在这种观测结构下，无需修改编码个体能力的策略即可学习有效的多智能体行为。

Authors: Elie Abboud, Oren Gal

Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control for an Omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot Using Control Barrier Function Other

Control Barrier Function Model Predictive Control Omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot collision avoidance human-robot collaboration

简要说明：本文提出了一种将控制屏障函数集成到模型预测控制中的安全约束控制框架，用于全向行走辅助机器人，并通过12名参与者的实验证明了其在降低能耗和减少碰撞方面的优势。

TLDR: This paper presents a safety-constrained MPC framework integrating Control Barrier Functions for an omnidirectional walking assistive robot, evaluated with 12 participants to show reduced energy consumption and fewer collisions compared to a variable admittance controller.

Abstract: Providing safe and effective mobility assistance plays a crucial role in restoring independence and enhancing the quality of life for individuals with motor impairments. In this context, robotic walking assistive devices have recently emerged as promising solutions to provide physically compliant interaction while ensuring user safety and support. This paper presents a novel control framework for an omnidirectional Walking Assistive Robot (I-WANDER) that integrates a Control Barrier Function (CBF) formulation into a Model Predictive Control (MPC) scheme to explicitly enforce collision-avoidance safety constraints while optimizing for energy efficiency and smooth human-robot collaboration. The method was experimentally evaluated with 12 healthy participants performing two different walking tasks using both the proposed CBF-based MPC controller (CB-MPC) and a variable admittance controller (AC). The first task involved structured navigation through a U-shaped corridor, whereas the second consisted of a single-obstacle avoidance task performed blindfolded to ensure the obstacle was unexpected. Comparative results show that the CB-MPC architecture significantly reduces energy consumption and mechanical work (p < 0.01) without compromising motion smoothness, while also decreasing the number of obstacle collisions. Overall, the findings highlight the potential of the proposed control architecture to enhance both safety and efficiency in robotic walking assistance.

摘要（中文）：提供安全有效的移动辅助对于恢复运动障碍患者的独立性并提高其生活质量至关重要。在此背景下，机器人步行辅助设备近年来已成为一种有前景的解决方案，既能提供物理上的柔顺交互，又能确保用户安全与支撑。本文提出了一种用于全向步行辅助机器人（I-WANDER）的新型控制框架，该框架将控制障碍函数（CBF）公式集成到模型预测控制（MPC）方案中，在显式强制执行避碰安全约束的同时，优化能量效率并实现平滑的人机协作。该方法通过12名健康参与者执行两种不同行走任务进行了实验评估，分别使用所提出的基于CBF的MPC控制器（CB-MPC）和可变导纳控制器（AC）。第一项任务涉及通过U形走廊的结构化导航，而第二项任务为在蒙眼条件下执行的单障碍物避让任务，以确保障碍物具有突发性。对比结果表明，CB-MPC架构在不影响运动平滑性的前提下显著降低了能耗和机械功（p < 0.01），同时减少了障碍物碰撞次数。总体而言，研究结果凸显了所提出的控制架构在增强机器人步行辅助的安全性和效率方面的潜力。

Authors: Andrea Fortuna, Marta Lorenzini, Elisa Motta, Alberto Ranavolo, Elena De Momi, Arash Ajoudani

Destination Support Restoration for Finite-Set Multimodal Trajectory Prediction Other

trajectory prediction destination support multimodal post-selection pedestrian

简要说明：DSR 是一种后选择算子，在不重新训练的情况下修复有限集多模态轨迹预测中的目的地支持，在爱丁堡数据集上提高了预测指标。

TLDR: DSR is a post-selection operator that repairs destination support in finite-set multimodal trajectory prediction without retraining, improving prediction metrics on the Edinburgh dataset.

Abstract: Robots operating around pedestrians often reason over a finite set of predicted human futures. Repeated online updates can concentrate this limited prediction budget on dominant destinations and leave plausible alternatives underrepresented or absent, removing those alternatives from the finite representation available to downstream decision making. We introduce Destination Support Restoration (DSR), a causal post-selection operator that repairs destination support without retraining the host predictor or increasing the maintained set size. At a repair step, DSR evaluates a temporary destination-stratified candidate bank from the observed prefix, converts candidate evidence into integer target counts, protects representatives of active modes, and reallocates redundant surplus hypotheses to deficient modes. The maintained and returned sets retain exactly $N$ hypotheses, and DSR replaces at most $\lceilρN\rceil$ entries. Protected representatives preserve current categorical support; lineage-aware particle filters also preserve surviving resampling ancestors. Each replacement reduces the allocation mismatch to the evidence-driven target by one. On the complete 3,719-trajectory Edinburgh protocol over three seeds, DSR reduces MIF weighted ADE and FDE by 13.36% and 13.30% at $N=64$. Paired integrations with CLiFF, PPT, causal GDTS, Social Informer, and PECNet improve both metrics in every evaluated pair. These results show that finite-set support allocation is a useful prediction-side control point when a fixed hypothesis set serves as the interface to downstream systems.

摘要（中文）：在行人周围运行的机器人，通常会对一组有限数量的预测性人类未来轨迹进行推理。反复的在线更新可能会将这一有限的预测预算集中于主导目的地，而使得其他可行的备选方案代表性不足或完全缺失，从而将这些备选方案从可供下游决策使用的有限表示中剔除。我们提出了目的地支持恢复（Destination Support Restoration, DSR）方法，这是一种因果后选择算子，能够在无需重新训练主预测器或增加所维护集合大小的情况下，修复目的地支持。在修复步骤中，DSR根据观测到的前缀评估一个临时性的、按目的地分层的候选库，将候选证据转换为整数目标计数，保护活跃模式的代表，并将冗余的剩余假设重新分配给不足的模式。所维护和返回的集合严格保持$N$个假设，DSR最多替换$\lceilρN\rceil$个条目。受保护的表示保留了当前的类别支持；具有谱系感知的粒子滤波器同样保留了存活的粒子重采样祖先。每次替换都会使分配偏差相较于证据驱动的目标减少一个单位。在完整包含3,719条轨迹的爱丁堡协议上，跨三个随机种子，DSR在$N=64$时将MIF加权ADE和FDE分别降低了13.36%和13.30%。与CLiFF、PPT、因果GDTS、Social Informer及PECNet的配对集成，在每一组评估中均改善了这两项指标。这些结果表明，当固定的假设集作为与下游系统交互的接口时，有限集合的支持分配是一个有效的预测侧控制点。

Unsigned Distance Maps on 2D Point Cloud Registration Other

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于移动机器人激光里程计和SLAM的2D点云配准方法，通过预计算无符号距离场替代迭代最近邻搜索，在合成和真实数据集上取得了有竞争力的漂移性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a 2D point cloud registration method for laser odometry and SLAM in mobile robots, using precomputed unsigned distance maps to replace iterative nearest-neighbor searches, achieving competitive drift on synthetic and real datasets.

Abstract: 2D point cloud registration arises in laser odometry and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) for mobile robots. Iterative Closest Point (ICP) is one of the most widely used approaches. Still, its iterative procedure recomputes correspondences via nearest-neighbor search at every iteration, whereas correspondence-free alternatives focus on scan-to-map alignment. This paper proposes a 2D point cloud registration approach based on unsigned distance maps, precomputing the Euclidean distance to the nearest reference point, along with its spatial derivatives, over a discrete grid, replacing the per-iteration search with O(1) lookups. Moreover, point-to-point and point-to-plane error formulations are derived on the SE(2) manifold and solved via Gauss-Newton optimization. On a synthetic benchmark and the real-world IILABS 3D dataset, the precomputed point-to-point variant outperforms its analytical counterparts, achieving competitive laser-odometry drift compared to point-to-plane formulations, as the precomputed gradient regularizes correspondences in the presence of sensor noise.

摘要（中文）：二维点云配准出现在移动机器人的激光里程计与同步定位与建图（SLAM）中。迭代最近点（ICP）是最广泛使用的方法之一。然而，其迭代过程在每次迭代中通过最近邻搜索重新计算对应关系，而无对应关系的方法则侧重于扫描到地图的对齐。本文提出了一种基于无符号距离图的二维点云配准方法，该方法在离散网格上预计算到最近参考点的欧氏距离及其空间导数，从而将每次迭代的搜索替换为O(1)复杂度的查找。此外，本文在SE(2)流形上推导了点对点和点对面误差公式，并通过高斯-牛顿优化进行求解。在合成基准测试和真实世界的IILABS 3D数据集上，预计算的点对点变体优于其解析对应方法，在激光里程计漂移方面与点对面公式相比具有竞争力，因为预计算的梯度在存在传感器噪声时对对应关系进行了正则化。

Authors: Ricardo B. Sousa, Giorgio Grisetti, Héber Miguel Sobreira, Carlos André Silva, António Paulo Moreira

Vision-based Underwater Formation Control With Input Saturations via Barrier Lyapunov Functions Other

vision-based control formation control barrier Lyapunov functions input saturation underwater robots

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于视觉的无通信水下机器人编队控制框架，利用重定心障碍李雅普诺夫函数处理感知和防撞约束，命令滤波反步法处理二阶动力学，并通过二次规划考虑执行器限制，在Gazebo SITL仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a communication-free vision-based formation control framework for underwater robots, using recentered barrier Lyapunov functions to handle sensing and collision constraints, command-filtered backstepping for second-order dynamics, and a quadratic program for actuator limits, validated in Gazebo SITL simulations.

Abstract: In this work, we propose a communication-free framework for vision-based formation control of fully actuated underwater robots subject to sensing constraints, collision-avoidance requirements, and input saturations. Recentered barrier Lyapunov functions encode sensing and collision-avoidance constraints, while command-filtered backstepping extends the design to the second-order vehicle dynamics. The resulting control objective is enforced through a quadratic program that explicitly accounts for actuator limits. Conservative sensing domains provide margins from the physical limits and are adaptively relaxed when necessary, allowing temporary violation of the conservative bounds. The proposed approach is validated through realistic Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) simulations in Gazebo.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种无通信框架，用于在传感约束、防碰撞需求及输入饱和条件下，实现全驱动水下机器人基于视觉的编队控制。通过重新中心化障碍李雅普诺夫函数来编码传感与避碰约束，同时采用指令滤波反步法将设计扩展至二阶车辆动力学。最终控制目标通过一个显式考虑执行器限制的二次规划问题来实现。保守的传感域为物理极限提供了裕度，并在必要时进行自适应松弛，从而允许对保守边界的临时超越。所提方法通过Gazebo环境中逼真的软件在环仿真进行了验证。

Authors: Nicola De Carli, João Zenário, Victor Nan Fernandez-Ayala, Dimos V. Dimarogonas

Robust Active-Perception Control for Global-State-Free Aerial-Ground Cooperation Perception3D

aerial-ground cooperation active perception model predictive control temporal convolutional network relative pose estimation

简要说明：本文提出COPA，一种用于空地协同的主动感知控制框架，通过单轴云台和TCN预测在MPC中联合优化无人机与云台控制，在无全局状态下保持对目标的持续可见。

TLDR: The paper presents COPA, an active-perception control framework for UAV-UGV cooperation that uses a gimbal and TCN-based predictions within MPC to maintain continuous target visibility without relying on global state estimates.

Abstract: Aerial-ground cooperation requires real-time UAV--UGV relative-state information. Instead of maintaining global estimates for both robots, direct control in a UGV-attached non-inertial frame avoids reliance on global localization. Vision-based relative pose estimation with a passive marker offers a low-cost and effective solution. However, a fixed camera may lose sight of the moving UGV when the required UAV attitude conflicts with the field-of-view (FOV) constraint. To address this, we propose COPA, a robust active-perception framework for global-state-free aerial-ground cooperation. We use a single-axis gimbal to decouple the camera optical axis from the UAV pitch attitude. We derive an active-perception model that relates UAV motion, gimbal angle, and UGV motion to the target image-plane state.A Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) predicts short-horizon UGV acceleration and angular velocity from recent motion history without global-state measurements. The model predictive control (MPC) uses these predictions to jointly optimize UAV and gimbal control. Simulations show that COPA maintains continuous target visibility, while ablation studies confirm that the TCN reduces peak errors during UGV motion transitions. Real-world experiments with UGV accelerations up to 3m/s^2 and yaw rates up to 1.0rad/s demonstrate robust tracking.

摘要（中文）：空地协同需要实时的无人机-无人车相对状态信息。相较于对两个机器人分别维持全局估计，在固连于无人车的非惯性坐标系中进行直接控制，可避免对全局定位的依赖。基于被动标记物的视觉相对位姿估计提供了一种低成本且有效的解决方案。然而，当所需的无人机姿态与视场约束相冲突时，固定相机可能丢失移动中无人车的视野。为解决这一问题，我们提出COPA，一种用于无全局状态空地协同的鲁棒主动感知框架。我们采用单轴云台将相机光轴与无人机俯仰姿态解耦，并推导出一个主动感知模型，将无人机运动、云台角度及无人车运动与目标图像平面状态关联起来。时间卷积网络（TCN）基于近期运动历史预测无人车短时加速度和角速度，无需全局状态测量。模型预测控制（MPC）利用这些预测对无人机与云台控制进行联合优化。仿真结果表明，COPA能够维持目标的持续可见性，消融研究证实TCN在无人车运动切换期间降低了峰值误差。在无人车加速度高达3m/s²、偏航角速度高达1.0rad/s的真实实验中，验证了其鲁棒的跟踪性能。

Abstract: This short report documents our entry to the COMFORT Localization Benchmark (IROS 2026), evaluated on the GrandTour dataset recorded with the Boxi payload. It extends MOLA-LO into a LiDAR-inertial system that also ingests IMU and, optionally, legged kinematic odometry. 摘要（中文）：本短文记录了我们在IROS 2026 COMFORT定位基准测试中的参赛工作，该测试基于使用Boxi载荷采集的GrandTour数据集进行评估。我们将MOLA-LO扩展为一种激光雷达-惯性系统，该系统同时融合IMU数据，并可选择性地加入腿式运动学里程计。本文描述了系统架构、所处理的数据流、用于选定提交配置的本地协议，以及支撑我们实时性声明的测量结果。

Authors: Jose Luis Blanco-Claraco

Minimal Recurrent Behavioral Memory for Imitation under Partial Observability Manipulation

recurrent behavioral memory partial observability imitation learning behavioral quotient sole-carrier measurement

简要说明：本文提出了一种部分可观测条件下模仿学习的最小循环行为记忆框架，刻画了复现专家行为所需的最少循环次数，并在隐藏模式扩展至512时证明了操纵任务中接近最优的比特需求。作者还提出了一种单一载体测量协议，以区分行为充分性与多余码率，并表明事件无关的未来行为监督有助于承诺但可能引发预测冗余。

TLDR: This paper introduces a minimal recurrent behavioral memory framework for imitation learning under partial observability, characterizing the least recurrence needed to reproduce expert behavior and demonstrating near-optimal bit requirements in manipulation tasks despite hidden modes scaling to 512. The authors also propose a sole-carrier measurement protocol to separate behavioral sufficiency from excess code rate, and show that event-agnostic future-behavior supervision aids commitment but can induce predictive surplus.

Abstract: What is the least recurrent memory needed to reproduce a specified expert under partial observability? The instantaneous requirement is the conditional entropy of the expert's behavioral quotient, but recurrence must also preserve distinctions that future observations will not restore before use. We characterize this minimal recurrent behavioral memory by a compatibility relation: under transitivity its classes attain the exact minimum, while the general case is an entropy minimization over closed compatible state assignments, with exact certificates on finite instances. A sole-carrier measurement protocol separates behavioral sufficiency, excess code rate, and information carried by observations or other memory paths; experimental bit requirements refer to the induced symbolic behavioral model under the stated occupancy. Across manipulation tasks, learned code rates remain near zero- and two-bit requirements as hidden modes grow to $512$, and anticipatory memory follows a $2\to1\to0$ requirement despite zero instantaneous demand during waiting. Learning this representation remains difficult: event-agnostic future-behavior supervision yields $36/40$ sufficient seeds with one frozen configuration and improves the longest-horizon pixel setting from $0/8$ to $6/8$ sufficient held-out seeds (closed-loop success from $0.08$ to $0.57$). On unmodified community benchmarks, the protocol certifies delay-independent requirements, which sufficient codes match at mid-delay. The supervision aids commitment but can induce predictive surplus; annealing it lets imitation and rate training reduce that surplus, separating the information-theoretic target from the ability to learn it.

摘要（中文）：摘要：在部分可观测条件下，重现特定专家所需的最少循环记忆是多少？瞬时需求是专家行为商的条件熵，但循环记忆还必须保留那些未来观测在使用前无法恢复的区分信息。我们通过一种兼容关系来刻画这种最小循环行为记忆：在传递性条件下，其类别达到精确最小值，而一般情形则是对封闭兼容状态分配上的熵最小化问题，在有限实例上具有精确验证。一种单载体测量协议将行为充分性、冗余码率以及由观测或其他记忆路径携带的信息分离开来；实验比特需求指的是在给定占用条件下所诱导的符号行为模型。在操作任务中，随着隐藏模式增长至512，学习得到的码率仍接近零比特和两比特需求，而预期记忆遵循2→1→0的需求模式，尽管在等待期间瞬时需求为零。学习这种表示仍然困难：与事件无关的未来行为监督产生36/40个充分种子，其中一个配置冻结，并将最长视距像素设置下的充分留出种子从0/8提升至6/8（闭环成功率从0.08提升至0.57）。在未经修改的社区基准上，该协议验证了与延迟无关的需求，充分码在中延迟情况下与之匹配。监督有助于承诺但可能引入预测冗余；对其退火处理使模仿学习和码率训练能够减少该冗余，从而将信息论目标与学习该目标的能力区分开来。

Authors: Xianyao Li, Fang Xu, Rui Min, Ruitong Tian, Jing Du

Dual Covariance Gaussian Splatting SLAM: Decoupling Rendering and Registration for Robust Real-Time Tracking Perception3D

3D Gaussian Splatting RGB-D SLAM dual covariance real-time tracking sensor noise model

简要说明：本文提出了一种双协方差三维高斯溅射SLAM系统，将渲染与配准协方差解耦，利用传感器噪声模型和角点高斯锚点实现鲁棒的实时RGB-D追踪。

TLDR: This paper presents a dual-covariance 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system that decouples rendering and registration covariances to enable robust real-time RGB-D tracking, using a sensor-noise model for tracking covariance and Gaussian anchors for image corners.

Abstract: ICP-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM tracks in real time by registering incoming frames against map Gaussians, using each primitive's covariance for both rendering and registration. These two uses place conflicting demands on one covariance. The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.

摘要（中文）：基于ICP的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）SLAM通过将新采集的帧与地图中的高斯原语进行配准来实现实时跟踪，其中每个原语的协方差同时用于渲染和配准。这两种用途对同一个协方差提出了相互矛盾的要求。建图模块为使光度误差最小化而塑造协方差，通常使其沿表面展平，而鲁棒的配准则通常受益于测量不确定性。我们提出了一种双协方差参数化方法。每个高斯原语保留单一均值，但拥有两个协方差：一个是由建图模块优化的渲染协方差，另一个是由RGB-D传感器噪声模型推导出的跟踪协方差。我们进一步将跟踪协方差用作图像角点的高斯锚点，在深度几何信息较弱的方向上提供约束。我们在TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica以及使用RealSense D435i在轮式平台和手持平台上录制的两组室外序列上进行了评估。我们在多种场景下实现了鲁棒的跟踪性能，并减少了里程计漂移，同时跟踪速度保持在约60帧/秒。

Photorealistic simulation Procedural generation Agricultural robotics Isaac Sim ROS

简要说明：AgriGen是一个基于Isaac Sim的ROS集成仿真框架，用于大规模程序化生成逼真的农业环境，支持行栽作物、果园和葡萄园，服务于机器人研究。

TLDR: AgriGen is a ROS-integrated simulation framework built on Isaac Sim for large-scale procedural generation of photorealistic agricultural environments, supporting row crops, orchards, and vineyards for robotics research.

Abstract: Agricultural robotics is advancing rapidly, yet progress remains constrained by limited field access, lack of control over field conditions, geographic variability, and seasonal crop cycles. These factors make it difficult and costly to acquire diverse agricultural datasets, resulting in limited evaluation and reduced system robustness. While other robotics domains have scaled learning and evaluation through high-fidelity simulation, agricultural robotics still lacks comparably capable tools. In this paper, we present a ROS-integrated framework, built on Isaac Sim, for large-scale procedural generation of agricultural environments. The framework supports photorealistic rendering, physics simulation, and domain randomization at scales relevant to robotics research, with built-in support for row crops, orchards, and vineyards and straightforward extensibility to additional crop categories. Project Page: https://baj31415.github.io/agrigen/

摘要（中文）：农业机器人技术正在快速发展，然而其进展仍受限于田间访问受限、对田间条件缺乏控制、地理差异以及季节性作物周期等因素。这些因素使得获取多样化的农业数据集变得困难且成本高昂，导致评估范围有限、系统鲁棒性不足。尽管其他机器人领域已通过高保真仿真实现了学习与评估的规模化，农业机器人领域仍缺乏同等能力水平的工具。在本文中，我们提出一个基于Isaac Sim构建、集成ROS的框架，用于农业环境的大规模程序化生成。该框架支持与机器人研究相关的规模化逼真渲染、物理仿真及域随机化，内置对行栽作物、果园和葡萄园的支持，并可便捷扩展至更多作物类别。项目页面：https://baj31415.github.io/agrigen/

Authors: Utkarsh Bajpai, Serge Tleiji, Cédric Pradalier, Stéphanie Aravecchia

Zephyron: Integrated Design and Analytical Evaluation of a Solar-Assisted Mobile Manipulator for Multimodal Environmental Reconnaissance and Distributed Visual Inference Other

mobile manipulator solar-assisted environmental reconnaissance distributed visual inference analytical design

简要说明：Zephyron 提出了一种基于文献的太阳能辅助移动机械臂工程设计与分析框架，针对环境侦察与分布式视觉推理，提供可复现的 3D 模型、组件基线和模拟性能场景。

TLDR: Zephyron presents a literature-informed engineering design and analytical framework for a solar-assisted mobile manipulator, focusing on environmental reconnaissance and distributed visual inference, with reproducible 3D models, component baselines, and simulated performance scenarios.

Abstract: Environmental reconnaissance needs mobile platforms that carry sensors, preserve measurement context, and return interpretable evidence under limited energy and communication. We present a literature-informed engineering design for Zephyron, a four-wheel rover with a front manipulator, environmental sensors, distributed computer vision, local recording, and a raised rear solar module. The design keeps the prototype layout but replaces unsupported numerical assumptions with an explicit component and geometry baseline. A reproducible search retrieved 5,000 records (4,858 unique) for screening, followed by targeted review of primary literature and manufacturer documentation. The baseline uses 165 mm wheels, a 12 kg mass budget, a 72 Wh battery-energy basis, and a 20 W photovoltaic module. With rolling-resistance coefficient 0.04, steady ascent of a 10 degree grade needs about 0.517 N m per wheel under equal load sharing. An illustrative 40 W motion load gives 1.44 h from 57.6 Wh usable energy, and a 25 percent driving duty gives 4.19 h without solar input; these are calculated scenarios, not measured performance. Sensor models show how integration time, calibration, temperature, and communication delay constrain interpretation, and a quality-aware stop-and-sample policy links these constraints to mission execution. Lightweight detectors, reference-based sensor learning, and executable data-integrity checks define a reproducible machine-learning evaluation pathway. The contribution is a traceable design and evaluation framework with editable 3D models, subsystem diagrams, and reproducible analytical data. Experimental validation is required before assigning payload, endurance, detection, or field-operating ratings.

摘要（中文）：环境侦察需要搭载传感器、保持测量情境并在有限能量与通信条件下返回可解释证据的移动平台。我们提出了一种基于文献的工程设计方案——Zephyron，这是一种四轮巡视器，配备前部机械臂、环境传感器、分布式计算机视觉、本地记录功能以及抬高的后置太阳能模块。该设计保留了原型布局，但将缺乏支撑的数值假设替换为明确的组件与几何基线。一项可复现的检索获取了5000条记录（其中4858条为唯一记录）用于筛选，随后对主要文献和制造商文档进行了定向综述。基线采用165毫米车轮、12千克质量预算、72瓦时电池能量基准以及20瓦光伏模块。在滚动阻力系数为0.04的条件下，均匀载荷分配下稳定爬升10度坡度每轮约需0.517牛·米扭矩。示例性40瓦运动负载在57.6瓦时可用能量下可持续1.44小时，25%行驶占空比下无太阳能输入时可持续4.19小时；这些为计算场景，而非实测性能。传感器模型展示了积分时间、校准、温度和通信延迟如何约束解释能力，一种质量感知的停止-采样策略将这些约束与任务执行联系起来。轻量级检测器、基于参考的传感器学习以及可执行的数据完整性检查定义了一条可复现的机器学习评估路径。本研究的贡献在于提供一个可追溯的设计与评估框架，包含可编辑的三维模型、子系统示意图和可复现的分析数据。在赋予有效载荷、续航、检测或野外运行等级评定之前，需要进行实验验证。

Authors: Sabik Bin Sultan, Shafi Bin Sultan, Safwan Sadad

MatcherCompass: A Deployment-Aware Benchmark to Guide Image Matcher Selection in the Wild Perception3D

image matching benchmark field robotics pose estimation runtime

简要说明：MatcherCompass 是一个部署感知基准，针对野外机器人，在多种硬件、分辨率和精度下评估九种图像匹配器，并基于运行时间、内存、能耗和位姿精度提供选择指南。

TLDR: MatcherCompass is a deployment-aware benchmark that evaluates nine image matchers across hardware, resolutions, and precisions for field robotics, providing a selection guide based on runtime, memory, energy, and pose accuracy.

Abstract: Field robots operating across time of day and sensing modalities require accurate image correspondences within onboard time and resource budgets. However, accuracy and runtime reported for individual methods on a single device provide limited guidance for choosing a matcher and its configuration on a target platform. We present MatcherCompass, a deployment-aware benchmark for choosing local feature matchers in field robotics. Under common input and pose-evaluation procedures, we compare nine classical and learned matching pipelines across four image resolutions and supported numerical precisions. Four visual conditions cover viewpoint variation, day--night matching in visible and thermal imagery, and daytime visible--thermal matching. We evaluate pose accuracy using the area under the error--recall curve (AUC) at $5^\circ$, $10^\circ$, and $20^\circ$, and measure runtime, GPU memory, and energy per image pair on four GPU platforms spanning workstation and onboard computers. The results show that changes in hardware, input resolution, and numerical precision can move a matcher across a runtime budget boundary, altering the feasible choices. We organize the measurements into a selection guide that returns all configurations satisfying user-specified time and resource limits, together with their accuracy under the selected visual condition. MatcherCompass provides measured evidence for choosing matching pipelines that fit a robot's sensing conditions and computing hardware. Project page: https://matchercompass.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：在不同时段和多传感模态下工作的野外机器人，需要在机载时间和资源预算内实现精确的图像对应匹配。然而，单一设备上针对个别方法报告的精度和运行时间，对于在目标平台上选择匹配器及其配置所提供的指导有限。我们提出了MatcherCompass，一个面向部署感知的基准测试工具，用于在野外机器人领域选择局部特征匹配器。在统一的输入和姿态评估流程下，我们比较了九种经典与学习型匹配流程，涵盖四种图像分辨率和所支持的数值精度。四种视觉条件涵盖了视角变化、可见光与热成像中的昼夜匹配，以及白天可见光与热成像的跨模态匹配。我们使用误差-召回率曲线下面积（AUC）在5°、10°和20°阈值下评估姿态精度，并在四个图形处理器（GPU）平台（涵盖工作站和机载计算机）上测量每对图像的运行时间、GPU内存和能耗。结果表明，硬件、输入分辨率和数值精度的变化可能将匹配器移动至运行时间预算边界之外，从而改变可行的配置选择。我们将测量结果整理为一份选择指南，该指南返回所有满足用户指定时间和资源限制的配置，并附上它们在所选视觉条件下的精度。MatcherCompass为选择适配机器人感知条件和计算硬件的匹配流程提供了基于实测的证据。项目页面：https://matchercompass.github.io/。

Authors: Hyunwoo Kim, Giseop Kim

Teaching Reinforcement Learning and Humanoid Robotics to High-School Students: An Expert-Validated Curriculum Design on a Low-Cost Open Platform RLRobot

reinforcement learning humanoid robotics curriculum design low-cost open platform high-school education

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向高中生的强化学习与人形机器人课程设计框架，基于开源低成本人形机器人平台，学生需完成硬件组装、仿真训练行走策略并在实体机器人上部署。该框架经过五位专家迭代评审，平衡了真实感与认知负荷、系统集成与进度可见性、团队协作与个人责任等核心矛盾。

TLDR: This paper presents a curriculum design framework for teaching reinforcement learning and humanoid robotics to high-school students, using an open-source low-cost humanoid robot platform where students assemble hardware, train walking policies in simulation, and deploy them on physical robots. The framework was iteratively developed and validated by five experts, addressing tensions between authenticity, cognitive load, system integration, team construction, and individual accountability.

Abstract: Lower cost open source robots and reinforcement learning (RL) simulation tools create new opportunities for precollege students to engage with contemporary robotics. However, translating a complete research workflow, spanning mechanical assembly, electrical setup, simulation, policy learning, system identification, and physical deployment, into a coherent course for novice learners remains challenging. We present an integrated robotics course framework that organizes these activities around a shared robotic artifact. The framework combines parallel disciplinary tracks, sequencing based on technical dependencies, progressive integration of simulation and hardware, layered performance checkpoints, and structures for balancing collaborative work with individual accountability. We illustrate the framework through a high school curriculum organized around a robot project in which pairs of students assemble an open source humanoid robot, train a walking policy in simulation, and deploy it on the physical platform. The framework was developed through an iterative design process that included formative review by five experts in robotics research, engineering, secondary STEM education, and curriculum design. Expert feedback highlighted three central design tensions: authenticity versus cognitive load, system integration versus timely visible progress, and team construction versus individual accountability. These tensions informed the final framework presented in this paper. This work offers a structured approach for adapting robotics research workflows into interdisciplinary precollege courses; future classroom studies are needed to examine implementation and student learning.

摘要（中文）：低成本的开源机器人和强化学习（RL）模拟工具为大学预科学生参与当代机器人技术创造了新的机会。然而，将涵盖机械装配、电气设置、仿真、策略学习、系统辨识及物理部署的完整研究工作流程，转化为面向初学者的连贯课程仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种整合式机器人课程框架，该框架围绕一个共享的机器人实体组织这些活动。该框架结合了并行学科轨道、基于技术依赖关系的排序、仿真与硬件的渐进整合、分层性能检查点，以及在协作工作与个人责任之间保持平衡的结构。我们通过一个以机器人项目为核心的高中课程展示了该框架，在该课程中，学生两人一组组装开源人形机器人，在仿真中训练行走策略，并将其部署到物理平台上。该框架通过迭代设计过程开发，包括五位来自机器人研究、工程、中学STEM教育和课程设计领域的专家的形成性评审。专家反馈强调了三个核心设计张力：真实性与认知负荷之间的张力、系统集成与及时可见进展之间的张力、团队构建与个人责任之间的张力。这些张力为本文提出的最终框架提供了依据。本研究为将机器人研究工作流程改编为跨学科的大学预科课程提供了一种结构化方法；未来需要开展课堂研究以检验实施效果与学生学习情况。

Authors: Yuanzhe Dong, Jie Cao, Shuman Wang

A Reconfigurable Bidirectional Cable-Driven Hip Exoskeleton with Swappable Bench/Backpack Dual-configuration Actuation Locomotion

hip exoskeleton cable-driven reconfigurable actuation wearable sensing gait dataset

简要说明：本文提出一种可重构的双向缆索驱动髋部外骨骼，可在台式与背包式驱动之间快速切换，兼顾实验室康复与移动辅助，并通过人体穿戴实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a reconfigurable bidirectional cable-driven hip exoskeleton that rapidly switches between bench-mounted and backpack-mounted actuation for both lab rehabilitation and mobile assistance, validated with human-worn experiments.

Abstract: Hip exoskeletons provide an important hardware basis for lower-limb rehabilitation and locomotor assistance. Laboratory rehabilitation assessment and system development require substantial actuation and computing resources, whereas mobile assistance requires untethered portability. Integrating both capabilities within one reusable platform remains a central design challenge. This paper presents a reconfigurable bidirectional cable-driven hip exoskeleton platform that rapidly switches between bench-mounted and backpack-mounted actuation while sharing one cable-free wearable hip interface. The platform modularly adapts the actuation configuration, end-effector sensing path, and low-level control interface. Each cable-driven end-effector weighs 0.405 kg, excluding the cable and actuation unit, and integrates an encoder and a torque sensor; experiments validated bench-mounted admittance-based motion tracking capability and backpack-mounted open-loop torque tracking. Human-worn experiments with three healthy participants used myoMOTION to evaluate the platform's wearable-side hip-motion sensing capability, verified bench-to-backpack and backpack-to-bench motion-ready switching across 30 trials in $30.1\pm16.3$ s, and formed a small-scale multimodal wearable-exoskeleton gait dataset for sensing validation and data-driven algorithm development, comprising 8 min bench-mounted treadmill records and 11 min backpack-mounted outdoor walking records. These results show that, by unifying the wearable structure, actuation interface, and sensing path, the proposed platform enables validation of the same hip exoskeleton in both bench-mounted and backpack-mounted configurations, providing reusable hardware for iterative development and applications across scenarios.

摘要（中文）：摘要：髋部外骨骼为下肢康复和运动辅助提供了重要的硬件基础。实验室康复评估和系统开发需要大量的驱动与计算资源，而移动辅助则要求无绳便携性。如何在同一个可复用平台上集成这两种能力，仍是一个核心设计挑战。本文提出了一种可重构的双向绳驱髋部外骨骼平台，该平台可在台架安装和背包安装两种驱动模式之间快速切换，同时共享一个无绳的可穿戴髋部接口。该平台模块化地调整驱动配置、末端执行器感知路径和底层控制接口。每个绳驱末端执行器重量为0.405 kg（不含绳索和驱动单元），并集成了编码器和力矩传感器；实验验证了台架安装模式下基于导纳的运动跟踪能力，以及背包安装模式下的开环力矩跟踪能力。三名健康受试者参与的人体穿戴实验使用myoMOTION评估了该平台可穿戴侧的髋部运动感知能力，验证了台架到背包及背包到台架的运动就绪切换，30次试验平均耗时$30.1\pm16.3$ s，并构建了一个小规模多模态可穿戴外骨骼步态数据集，用于感知验证和数据驱动算法开发，包含8分钟台架 treadmill 记录和11分钟背包户外行走记录。结果表明，通过统一可穿戴结构、驱动接口和感知路径，所提出的平台能够在台架安装和背包安装两种配置下对同一髋部外骨骼进行验证，为跨场景的迭代开发和应用程序提供了可复用的硬件基础。

Authors: YuanLong Ji, Shuhan Xiang, Qihan Ye, Xingbang Yang

A Deployment Study of Identity-Gated Drone Gesture Control Other

drone control gesture recognition face verification identity-gated human-robot interaction

简要说明：本文提出了 IGate，一种身份门控的无人机控制栈，通过人脸验证和手势识别，确保只有注册操作员的命令被接受，并在 DJI Tello EDU 无人机上进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper presents IGate, an identity-gated drone control stack using face verification and gesture recognition to ensure commands are only accepted from an enrolled operator, evaluated on a DJI Tello EDU drone.

Abstract: Vision-based gesture control accepts commands from any hand in the camera field of view, which is unsafe in shared indoor spaces. This paper presents IGate, an identity-gated control stack that includes gesture control and face tracking, in which commands are admitted only when an enrolled operator is verified. The system performs few-shot user enrolment from 20 initial face frames, without prior user-specific training: verification compares an embedding of the current face crop against the enrolled template by cosine similarity, while face tracking uses proportional correction. Gesture control is achieved by classifying extracted hand landmarks using an RBF-SVM trained on a custom dataset. Additionally, a hierarchical finite-state machine handles mode selection, default, and fallback behaviours. The approach is tested on a DJI Tello EDU, each component evaluated offline and in-flight across 270 trials (149 flown). Face verification yields a 0.32% offline equal error rate versus 19.3% in-flight. Under hover-locked conditions, the RBF-SVM gesture classifier outperforms the geometric rule (0.850 vs. 0.651 accuracy), with 82% of this gap stemming from the depth channel. All logs and reproduction scripts will be released.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的手势控制会接受摄像机视野内任何手部的命令，这在共享室内空间中是不安全的。本文提出了IGate，一种身份门控控制栈，包含手势控制与人脸跟踪功能，仅当已注册操作员通过验证时才允许执行命令。该系统通过20帧初始人脸图像实现少样本用户注册，无需预先进行用户特定训练：验证过程将当前人脸裁剪区域的嵌入向量与已注册模板通过余弦相似度进行比较，而人脸跟踪则采用比例校正方法。手势控制通过使用在自定义数据集上训练的RBF-SVM对提取的手部关键点进行分类来实现。此外，分层有限状态机负责处理模式选择、默认行为和回退行为。该方法在DJI Tello EDU上进行测试，每个组件均经过离线和飞行评估，共进行270次试验（其中149次为实际飞行）。人脸验证离线等错误率为0.32%，飞行中为19.3%。在悬停锁定条件下，RBF-SVM手势分类器优于几何规则方法（准确率0.850对0.651），其中82%的性能差距来源于深度通道。所有日志和复现脚本将予以公开。
