Authors: Diyari Mohammed Salih, Ilyes Chaabeni, Naima Ait Oufroukh

A bioinspired internal model-based online estimator for planar pursuit Other

bioinspired estimator internal model online estimation pursuit Pontryagin's Maximum Principle

简要说明：本文提出一种基于生物启发内部模型的估计器，从部分传感器观测和自运动中重建未观测的相对构型量，用于追踪任务，并在机器人硬件上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a bioinspired internal model-based estimator that reconstructs unobserved relative configuration quantities from partial sensory data and self-motion for pursuit tasks, validated on robotic hardware.

Abstract: Bioinspired feedback controls for pursuit, tracking, and collective motion are often expressed in terms of the relative configuration between interacting agents. In practice, however, onboard sensors may not directly provide all quantities required for feedback control, necessitating estimation of unobserved quantities. This paper develops a bioinspired internal model-based estimator for reconstructing those quantities from partial sensory observations and known self-motion. State reconstruction is posed as an optimization problem that treats the relative kinematics as constraints and minimizes the disagreement between the internal model outputs and measurements from onboard sensors. Pontryagin's Maximum Principle is used to derive the necessary optimality conditions. A forward-backward algorithm is used to provide a numerical solution and a moving horizon formulation is employed for online implementation. The estimator is evaluated numerically against classical state estimators. Real-time implementation of the proposed framework on robotic hardware is demonstrated through two pursuit strategies.

摘要（中文）：基于生物启发的反馈控制，用于追踪、跟踪及群体运动时，通常以相互作用个体之间的相对构型来表达。然而，在实践中，机载传感器可能无法直接提供反馈控制所需的全部量，因此有必要对未观测到的量进行估计。本文开发了一种基于生物启发的内模型估计器，用于从部分感官观测和已知自运动中重建这些量。状态重建被构造成一个优化问题，该问题将相对运动学视为约束条件，并最小化内模型输出与机载传感器测量值之间的不一致性。利用庞特里亚金极大值原理推导了必要性最优条件。采用前向-后向算法进行数值求解，并采用滚动时域公式进行在线实现。该估计器在数值上与传统状态估计器进行了对比评估。通过在两种追击策略中的演示，验证了所提框架在机器人硬件上的实时实现。

Authors: Tengyue Liu, Xincheng Li, Sofia Morales Ferreira, Kevin Galloway, Udit Halder

Norm2Tex: Augmenting Visuo-Tactile Simulations with Texture Other

tactile simulation normal map textures sim-to-real transfer material classification reinforcement learning

简要说明：Norm2Tex 是一种即插即用方法，通过法线贴图纹理增强视觉触觉仿真，保留材料相关的触觉信息，并改进机器人控制策略的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: Norm2Tex is a plug-in method that augments visuo-tactile simulations with normal map textures to preserve material-dependent tactile information and improve sim-to-real transfer for robot control policies.

Abstract: Large-scale datasets are essential for training generalist robot control policies. Collecting real-world tactile data is costly and time-consuming, motivating the use of tactile simulations. However, current tactile simulators capture only overall contact geometry and miss fine details like texture. This results in a significant domain shift between simulated and real tactile data. To address this gap, we introduce Norm2Tex, a plug-in method that augments simulations of vision-based tactile sensors with high-frequency surface details from normal map textures. By modifying the target object's depth map before a tactile simulator's rendering pipeline, Norm2Tex seamlessly integrates into different tactile simulators. We also evaluate sim-to-real transfer using material classification and a reinforcement learning task. Our results show that Norm2Tex preserves material-dependent tactile information across domains, improving texture recognition and producing material-dependent control behavior in the real world.

摘要（中文）：大规模数据集对于训练通用型机器人控制策略至关重要。采集真实触觉数据成本高昂且耗时，因此推动了触觉模拟技术的应用。然而，现有的触觉模拟器仅能捕捉整体的接触几何信息，而遗漏了如纹理等精细细节，这导致模拟触觉数据与真实触觉数据之间存在显著的数据域差异。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了Norm2Tex，一种即插即用的方法，通过利用法线贴图纹理中的高频表面细节来增强基于视觉的触觉传感器的模拟效果。通过在触觉模拟器渲染管线之前修改目标物体的深度图，Norm2Tex能够无缝集成到不同的触觉模拟器中。我们还利用材料分类和强化学习任务评估了从模拟到现实的迁移效果。结果表明，Norm2Tex能够跨数据域保留与材料相关的触觉信息，提升纹理识别能力，并在现实世界中产生与材料相关的控制行为。

Authors: Seongjin Bien, Débora Oliveira Makowski, Roberto Calandra, Florian Walter, Wolfram Burgard

Towards Systematic Qualification of Vision-Language Models for Automotive Perception Systems AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language Models hallucination automotive perception design-time verification nuScenes dataset

简要说明：本文提出了一种设计时资格认证工作流程，结合基于本体的结构化标注和基于同义词的评估方法，在nuScenes数据上统计评估三个VLM的幻觉现象，以补充车载感知的运行时监控。

TLDR: This paper proposes a design-time qualification workflow combining ontology-based structured annotation and synonym-based evaluation to statistically assess hallucinations of three VLMs on nuScenes data, complementing run-time monitoring for automotive perception.

Abstract: The field of Artificial Intelligence has been adopted for many application domains. Vision Language Models are one of the recently advanced AI techniques that have been explored to support automotive features such as vehicle perception, and safety assurance. However, such language models are prone to hallucinations, posing a potential threat to the safety of automotive systems that may incorporate them. Within the automotive domain, VLMs could not only hallucinate traffic objects, but could also fail to identify traffic objects that are actually present, which may potentially lead to dangerous situations. Though we have observed a growing body of literature that proposes verification and validation techniques for safe and trustworthy AI, these methods are often studied in isolation, focusing either on run-time or design-time phases. Such isolated techniques could be insufficient in safety-critical, realistic contexts such as automotive perception systems. In this paper, we analyze design-time and run-time verification and validation techniques based on a taxonomy presented by Huang et al. We present an automotive study in which a design-time qualification workflow is proposed to complement run-time monitoring. This workflow combines a fixed safety-relevant ontology-based structured annotation system together with a synonym-based evaluation process to statistically evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs against data from the nuScenes dataset. We observed that the proposed technique enables deterministic and repeatable quantification of the hallucinations VLMs generate in automotive perception-related tasks. The proposed workflow supports model comparison and deployment-oriented engineering decisions within the design-time verification and validation process and will contribute to a holistic verification strategy that strives towards trustworthy automotive perception systems

摘要（中文）：人工智能领域已被广泛应用于众多应用领域。视觉语言模型是近年来先进的人工智能技术之一，已被探索用于支持车辆感知、安全保障等汽车功能。然而，这类语言模型容易产生幻觉，对可能集成这些模型的汽车系统安全性构成潜在威胁。在汽车领域，视觉语言模型不仅可能幻觉出并不存在的交通对象，还可能无法识别实际存在的交通对象，这可能导致危险情况的发生。尽管我们观察到越来越多的文献提出了面向安全可信人工智能的验证与确认技术，但这些方法往往被孤立地研究，要么侧重于运行时阶段，要么侧重于设计时阶段。在安全攸关的现实场景（如汽车感知系统）中，这种孤立的技术可能是不够的。在本文中，我们基于Huang等人提出的分类体系，分析了设计时和运行时的验证与确认技术。我们提出了一项汽车研究，其中设计了一个设计时合格性工作流，以补充运行时监控。该工作流将基于固定安全相关本体的结构化标注系统与基于同义词的评估过程相结合，针对nuScenes数据集中的数据对三种最先进的视觉语言模型进行统计评估。我们观察到，所提出的技术能够对视觉语言模型在汽车感知相关任务中产生的幻觉进行确定性和可重复的量化。该工作流支持设计时验证与确认过程中的模型比较和面向部署的工程决策，并将有助于形成一种整体验证策略，以追求可信的汽车感知系统。
